```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { completeAttempt, submitAnswer } from "@/lib/brainiac";
import type {
  BrainiacAttemptDetail,
  BrainiacAttemptQuestion,
  BrainiacAttemptSummary,
} from "@/lib/brainiac-types";

function formatClock(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const rem = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${rem.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export function QuizRunner({
  attempt,
  initialQuestions,
  onFinished,
}: {
  attempt: BrainiacAttemptSummary;
  initialQuestions: BrainiacAttemptQuestion[];
  onFinished: (detail: BrainiacAttemptDetail) => void;
}) {
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState(initialQuestions);
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(attempt.time_remaining_seconds);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingOption, setPendingOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const finishingRef = useRef(false);

  const finish = async () => {
    if (finishingRef.current) return;
    finishingRef.current = true;
    try {
      const detail = await completeAttempt(attempt.id);
      onFinished(detail);
    } catch {
      setError("Couldn't submit the assessment. Try again.");
      finishingRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setRemaining((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          finish();
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const current = questions[index];
  const answeredCount = questions.filter((q) => q.selected_option !== null).length;

  async function handleSelect(optionIndex: number) {
    setError(null);
    setPendingOption(optionIndex);

    const prevQuestions = questions;
    setQuestions((qs) =>
      qs.map((q) =>
        q.id === current.id
          ? { ...q, selected_option: optionIndex, is_correct: null }
          : q,
      ),
    );

    try {
      const updated = await submitAnswer(
        attempt.id,
        current.question_id,
        optionIndex,
      );
      setQuestions((qs) => qs.map((q) => (q.id === current.id ? updated : q)));
    } catch {
      setQuestions(prevQuestions);
      setError("Couldn't save that answer — try again.");
    } finally {
      setPendingOption(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleFinish() {
    if (!confirm("Finish and submit your answers now?")) return;
    await finish();
  }

  if (!current) return null;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <span className="text-zinc-500">
          Question {index + 1} of {questions.length} · {answeredCount} answered
        </span>
        <span
          className={`font-mono font-medium ${remaining <= 60 ? "text-red-600 dark:text-red-500" : ""}`}
        >
          {formatClock(remaining)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {questions.map((q, i) => {
          const isCurrent = i === index;
          const isAnswered = q.selected_option !== null;
          return (
            <button
              key={q.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIndex(i)}
              className={`h-7 w-7 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                isCurrent
                  ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                  : isAnswered
                    ? "border border-black/10 bg-black/5 dark:border-white/10 dark:bg-white/10"
                    : "border border-black/10 text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              {i + 1}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="mb-4 rounded border border-black/10 p-6 dark:border-white/10">
        <p className="mb-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">
          {current.category}
        </p>
        <p className="mb-4 text-base">{current.prompt}</p>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {current.options.map((option, optionIndex) => {
            const selected = current.selected_option === optionIndex;
            return (
              <button
                key={optionIndex}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSelect(optionIndex)}
                disabled={pendingOption !== null}
                className={`rounded border px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm disabled:opacity-50 ${
                  selected
                    ? "border-foreground bg-foreground/5"
                    : "border-black/10 dark:border-white/10"
                }`}
              >
                {option}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIndex((i) => Math.max(0, i - 1))}
            disabled={index === 0}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            Previous
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIndex((i) => Math.min(questions.length - 1, i + 1))}
            disabled={index === questions.length - 1}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            Next
          </button>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleFinish}
          className="rounded bg-foreground px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-background"
        >
          Finish
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import type { BrainiacAttemptDetail, BrainiacCategory } from "@/lib/brainiac-types";

const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<BrainiacCategory, string> = {
  numerical: "Numerical",
  verbal: "Verbal",
  abstract: "Abstract",
};

export function AttemptResults({
  detail,
  onBack,
  onRetake,
}: {
  detail: BrainiacAttemptDetail;
  onBack: () => void;
  onRetake: () => void;
}) {
  const { attempt, questions } = detail;

  const byCategory = (Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS) as BrainiacCategory[]).map(
    (category) => {
      const inCategory = questions.filter((q) => q.category === category);
      const correct = inCategory.filter((q) => q.is_correct).length;
      return { category, correct, total: inCategory.length };
    },
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-6 rounded border border-black/10 p-6 dark:border-white/10">
        <h2 className="mb-1 text-lg font-semibold">Results</h2>
        <p className="mb-4 text-3xl font-semibold">
          {attempt.score} / {attempt.total_questions}
          <span className="ml-2 text-base font-normal text-zinc-500">
            ({attempt.percent_correct}%)
          </span>
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-6 text-sm text-zinc-500">
          {byCategory.map(({ category, correct, total }) => (
            <span key={category}>
              {CATEGORY_LABELS[category]}: {correct}/{total}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mb-6 flex gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetake}
          className="rounded bg-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-background"
        >
          Start another attempt
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          className="rounded border border-black/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium dark:border-white/10"
        >
          Back to history
        </button>
      </div>

      <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Review</h3>
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <li
            key={q.id}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 text-sm dark:border-white/10"
          >
            <p className="mb-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">
              {i + 1}. {CATEGORY_LABELS[q.category]}
            </p>
            <p className="mb-2">{q.prompt}</p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              {q.options.map((option, optionIndex) => {
                const isCorrect = optionIndex === q.correct_option;
                const isSelected = optionIndex === q.selected_option;
                return (
                  <p
                    key={optionIndex}
                    className={
                      isCorrect
                        ? "font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-500"
                        : isSelected
                          ? "font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-500"
                          : "text-zinc-500"
                    }
                  >
                    {isCorrect ? "✓" : isSelected ? "✗" : "·"} {option}
                  </p>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {q.selected_option === null && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">Not answered</p>
            )}
            {q.explanation && (
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">{q.explanation}</p>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getAttempt, listAttempts, startAttempt } from "@/lib/brainiac";
import type { BrainiacAttemptDetail, BrainiacAttemptSummary } from "@/lib/brainiac-types";
import { AttemptHistory } from "./attempt-history";
import { AttemptResults } from "./attempt-results";
import { QuizRunner } from "./quiz-runner";

type View =
  | { name: "loading" }
  | { name: "history"; attempts: BrainiacAttemptSummary[] }
  | { name: "active"; detail: BrainiacAttemptDetail }
  | { name: "results"; detail: BrainiacAttemptDetail };

export function BrainiacAssessment() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>({ name: "loading" });
  const [starting, setStarting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;

    listAttempts()
      .then(async (attempts) => {
        if (ignore) return;

        const inProgress = attempts.find((a) => !a.completed);
        if (inProgress) {
          const detail = await getAttempt(inProgress.id);
          if (!ignore) setView({ name: "active", detail });
          return;
        }

        setView({ name: "history", attempts });
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!ignore) setError("Couldn't load your Brainiac history.");
      });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, []);

  async function refreshHistory() {
    const attempts = await listAttempts();
    setView({ name: "history", attempts });
  }

  async function handleStart() {
    setStarting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const detail = await startAttempt();
      setView({ name: "active", detail });
    } catch {
      setError("Couldn't start a new assessment. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setStarting(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleResume(id: number) {
    setError(null);
    try {
      const detail = await getAttempt(id);
      setView({ name: "active", detail });
    } catch {
      setError("Couldn't resume that attempt.");
    }
  }

  async function handleViewResults(id: number) {
    setError(null);
    try {
      const detail = await getAttempt(id);
      setView({ name: "results", detail });
    } catch {
      setError("Couldn't load those results.");
    }
  }

  if (view.name === "loading") {
    return <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading...</p>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">Brainiac</h1>
      {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

      {view.name === "history" && (
        <AttemptHistory
          attempts={view.attempts}
          starting={starting}
          onStart={handleStart}
          onResume={handleResume}
          onViewResults={handleViewResults}
        />
      )}

      {view.name === "active" && (
        <QuizRunner
          attempt={view.detail.attempt}
          initialQuestions={view.detail.questions}
          onFinished={(detail) => setView({ name: "results", detail })}
        />
      )}

      {view.name === "results" && (
        <AttemptResults
          detail={view.detail}
          onBack={() => void refreshHistory()}
          onRetake={handleStart}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

```text
#[Fillable(['name', 'site_url', 'feed_url'])]
class NewsSource extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<\Database\Factories\NewsSourceFactory> */

class FeedController extends Controller
{
    /** Each point of source affinity shifts an article's effective recency by this many hours. */
    private const AFFINITY_HOURS = 6;

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $limit = min((int) $request->integer('limit', 50), 100);
        $query = trim((string) $request->string('q'));

        $sourceIds = $user
            ? $user->newsSources()->pluck('news_sources.id')
            : NewsSource::where('is_default', true)->pluck('id');

        if ($sourceIds->isEmpty()) {
            return NewsArticleResource::collection(collect());
        }

        $articlesQuery = NewsArticle::with('source')
            ->whereIn('news_source_id', $sourceIds);

        if ($query !== '') {
            $escaped = str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $query);
            $articlesQuery->where(function ($inner) use ($escaped) {
                $inner->where('title', 'like', "%{$escaped}%")
                    ->orWhere('summary', 'like', "%{$escaped}%");
            });
        }

        $articles = $articlesQuery
            ->orderByDesc('published_at')
            ->limit(300)
            ->get();

        $affinity = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->select('news_source_id', DB::raw('SUM(direction) as score'))
                ->groupBy('news_source_id')
                ->pluck('score', 'news_source_id')
            : collect();

        $viewerFeedback = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->whereIn('news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))
                ->pluck('direction', 'news_article_id')
            : collect();

        $articles = $articles
            ->sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($affinity) {
                $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
                $boost = (int) ($affinity->get($article->news_source_id) ?? 0);

                return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
            })
            ->values()
            ->take($limit);

        $articles->each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($viewerFeedback) {
            $article->viewer_feedback = $viewerFeedback->has($article->id)
                ? (int) $viewerFeedback->get($article->id)
                : null;
        });

        return NewsArticleResource::collection($articles);
    }
}
```

```text
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\NewsSourceResource;
use App\Models\NewsSource;
use App\Rules\SafeFeedUrl;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class SourceController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $sources = NewsSource::orderBy('name')->get();

        $positions = $request->user()
            ? DB::table('news_source_user')
                ->where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
                ->pluck('position', 'news_source_id')
            : collect();

        $sources->each(function (NewsSource $source) use ($positions) {
            $source->added_position = $positions->has($source->id) ? (int) $positions->get($source->id) : null;
        });

        return NewsSourceResource::collection($sources);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'news_source_id' => ['required_without:feed_url', 'integer', 'exists:news_sources,id'],
            'name' => ['required_with:feed_url', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'feed_url' => ['required_without:news_source_id', 'url', 'max:2048', new SafeFeedUrl],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['news_source_id'])) {
            $source = NewsSource::findOrFail($validated['news_source_id']);
        } else {
            $source = NewsSource::firstOrCreate(
                ['feed_url' => $validated['feed_url']],
                [
                    'name' => $validated['name'],
                    'site_url' => $validated['feed_url'],
                ],
            );
            // is_default isn't mass-assignable (kept off the model's fillable
            // list so it can never be set from request input); the DB column
            // default (false) applies on insert, but refresh so the in-memory
            // model reflects it instead of showing null on this response.
            $source->refresh();
        }

        if (! $user->newsSources()->where('news_sources.id', $source->id)->exists()) {
            $nextPosition = (int) ($user->newsSources()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;
            $user->newsSources()->attach($source->id, ['position' => $nextPosition]);
        }

        $source->added_position = $user->newsSources()
            ->where('news_sources.id', $source->id)
            ->value('position');

        return new NewsSourceResource($source);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, NewsSource $source)
    {
        $request->user()->newsSources()->detach($source->id);

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function reorder(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'source_ids' => ['required', 'array'],
            'source_ids.*' => ['integer'],
        ]);

        $ownedIds = $user->newsSources()->pluck('news_sources.id');

        foreach (array_values($validated['source_ids']) as $position => $sourceId) {
            if (! $ownedIds->contains($sourceId)) {
                continue;
            }

            DB::table('news_source_user')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->where('news_source_id', $sourceId)
                ->update(['position' => $position]);
        }

        return $this->index($request);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\NewsSource;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class NewsSourceSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $sources = [
            [
                'name' => 'WSJ',
                'site_url' => 'https://www.wsj.com',
                'feed_url' => 'https://feeds.a.dj.com/rss/RSSWorldNews.xml',
                'topic' => null,
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'CBC',
                'site_url' => 'https://www.cbc.ca',
                'feed_url' => 'https://rss.cbc.ca/lineup/topstories.xml',
                'topic' => null,
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'BBC',
                'site_url' => 'https://www.bbc.com/news',
                'feed_url' => 'http://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml',
                'topic' => null,
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'Al Jazeera',
                'site_url' => 'https://www.aljazeera.com',
                'feed_url' => 'https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml',
                'topic' => null,
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'Techdirt',
                'site_url' => 'https://www.techdirt.com',
                'feed_url' => 'https://www.techdirt.com/techdirt_rss.xml',
                'topic' => null,
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'Bay Observer',
                'site_url' => 'https://bayobserver.ca',
                'feed_url' => 'https://bayobserver.ca/feed/',
                'topic' => 'local',
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'Hamilton Independent',
                'site_url' => 'https://hamiltonindependent.ca',
                'feed_url' => 'https://hamiltonindependent.ca/feed/',
                'topic' => 'local',
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'The Local',
                'site_url' => 'https://thelocal.to',
                'feed_url' => 'https://thelocal.to/feed/',
                'topic' => 'local',
            ],
        ];

        $newlyDefaulted = collect();

        foreach ($sources as $source) {
            ['topic' => $topic, ...$attributes] = $source;

            $existed = NewsSource::where('feed_url', $source['feed_url'])->exists();

            $newsSource = NewsSource::updateOrCreate(
                ['feed_url' => $attributes['feed_url']],
                $attributes,
            );

            // is_default/topic aren't mass-assignable (see NewsSource's
            // fillable list — that's deliberate so a user's own add-source
            // request can never set them), so the catalog-seeding values
            // have to go through forceFill instead.
            $newsSource->forceFill(['is_default' => true, 'topic' => $topic])->save();

            if (! $existed) {
                $newlyDefaulted->push($newsSource);
            }
        }

        if ($newlyDefaulted->isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // New is_default sources only auto-attach to users created from now
        // on (see SsoController::callback); backfill everyone who already
        // has an account so they see the new topic too.
        User::all()->each(function (User $user) use ($newlyDefaulted) {
            $alreadyHas = $user->newsSources()->pluck('news_sources.id');
            $toAttach = $newlyDefaulted->reject(fn ($s) => $alreadyHas->contains($s->id));

            if ($toAttach->isEmpty()) {
                return;
            }

            $nextPosition = (int) ($user->newsSources()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;

            $user->newsSources()->attach(
                $toAttach->values()->mapWithKeys(
                    fn ($s, $i) => [$s->id => ['position' => $nextPosition + $i]],
                ),
            );
        });
    }
}
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 13:26:00Z)**_

Working live in production end-to-end. Summary of what's built:

**Backend:**
- Migration adding a `topic` column to `news_sources`
- `NewsSourceSeeder` rewritten to add Bay Observer, Hamilton Independent, and The Local as `is_default` catalog sources tagged `topic: 'local'` — and **fixed a real latent bug** I found along the way: `is_default` had been silently dropped by mass-assignment guards for any *newly* seeded source since a security fix was added after the original 5 sources existed, so new default sources wouldn't have actually defaulted. Now uses `forceFill` (safe here — seeder input, not user input) and backfills existing users so everyone gets the new sources without needing to re-register
- `FeedController` accepts an optional `?topic=` filter
- `NewsSourceResource` now exposes `topic`

**Frontend:**
- Topic sub-nav (`All` / `Local`) above the news feed, filtering articles by topic
- `NewsSource`/`getFeed` types and client updated

Verified live: all three feeds fetch correctly (`php artisan news:fetch`), the topic filter returns only local articles, and it works for both logged-in and guest views since these are `is_default` sources. Not committed yet — let me know if you want that, and whether you'd like more topics scaffolded now or later.

```text
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsArticleFeedback;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class FeedbackController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'direction' => ['required', 'integer', 'in:1,-1'],
        ]);

        NewsArticleFeedback::updateOrCreate(
            ['user_id' => $request->user()->id, 'news_article_id' => $article->id],
            ['news_source_id' => $article->news_source_id, 'direction' => $validated['direction']],
        );

        return response()->json(['direction' => $validated['direction']]);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        NewsArticleFeedback::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->where('news_article_id', $article->id)
            ->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 14:16:45Z)**_

This isn't something that needs a plan — it's a read-only question about existing behavior. Here's exactly what happens, based on the actual code (`FeedbackController.php` and `FeedController.php`):

## What clicking the button does

Each article has a **source** (e.g. "BBC", "Bellingcat"). When you click "More like this" or "Less like this" on an article:

1. It writes one row to `news_article_feedback`: `{user_id, news_article_id, news_source_id, direction}` where `direction` is `+1` (more) or `-1` (less).
2. Clicking the button again toggles it off (deletes the row) — clicking the opposite button overwrites the row (`updateOrCreate`, keyed on `user_id` + `news_article_id`).

## What it actually affects

**It's a per-source signal, not per-article and not per-topic.** Voting on one article shifts that article's *source* up or down for you — it has no effect on that specific article beyond that, and no effect on other articles from other sources, and no notion of "topic" (Local/Hackery/World) or keyword/content similarity at all.

Concretely, at feed-build time:
- Your votes are summed per source: `affinity_score(source) = SUM(direction)` across every article you've rated from that source.
- Every article's normal sort key (its `published_at` timestamp) gets shifted by `affinity_score(source) × 6 hours`.
- The feed is then sorted by that adjusted timestamp, descending.

So if you've net-upvoted a source twice (+2), every article from that source is sorted as if it were published **12 hours more recently** than it actually was — pushing that source's articles higher in your feed. A net downvote pushes articles from that source lower the same way. It's pure re-ranking of your existing selected sources' articles — it never adds or removes sources, and never fetches new content.

**One nuance:** because it's keyed on the *article*, voting counts once per article you've rated, not once per click session — if you'd already upvoted an article from Bellingcat and then downvote a *different* Bellingcat article, your net score for Bellingcat becomes 0, since `updateOrCreate` is per-article and the sum is across all your feedback rows for that source.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 14:18:43Z)**_

A good approach: the schema already stores `news_article_id` per feedback row, it's just unused for ranking — so no schema change is needed. I'd add a **separate, stronger per-article effect on top of** the existing source-level aggregate: an upvote gives that specific article a large recency boost (so it jumps to the top now), and a downvote hides that specific article from your feed going forward (rather than just demoting it, since "less like this" on a single article you've already seen reads more as "stop showing me this one" than "nudge it down").

The main tradeoff: this conflates two different signals under the same two buttons — "teach my source preferences" (existing) vs. "judge this one article" (new). If you want them kept conceptually separate rather than layered, the cleaner alternative is a third action (e.g., "hide") instead of overloading "less like this."

```typescript
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";

const TABS = [
  { href: "/news", label: "News Feed", requiresAuth: false },
  { href: "/market", label: "Market Info", requiresAuth: false },
  { href: "/todo", label: "Todo", requiresAuth: true },
  { href: "/gig-leads", label: "Gig Leads", requiresAuth: true },
  { href: "/weather", label: "Weather", requiresAuth: false },
  { href: "/brainiac", label: "Brainiac", requiresAuth: true },
] as const;

function AuthControls({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  const { user, status, logout } = useAuth();

  if (status === "authenticated" && user) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-center md:gap-3">
        <span className="text-zinc-500">{user.email}</span>
        <Link
          href="/account"
          onClick={onNavigate}
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >
          Account
        </Link>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            logout();
            onNavigate?.();
          }}
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >
          Log out
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === "unauthenticated") {
    return (
      <Link
        href="/login"
        onClick={onNavigate}
        className="font-medium hover:underline"
      >
        Log in
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return null;
}

export function TabNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setOpen(false);
  }, [pathname]);

  return (
    <nav className="border-b border-black/10 dark:border-white/10">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-4">
        <ul className="hidden flex-wrap gap-1 md:flex">
          {TABS.map((tab) => {
            const active = pathname === tab.href;
            return (
              <li key={tab.href}>
                <Link
                  href={tab.href}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 px-3 py-3 text-sm font-medium ${
                    active
                      ? "border-foreground text-foreground"
                      : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground"
                  }`}
                >
                  {tab.label}
                  {tab.requiresAuth && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                      (login required)
                    </span>
                  )}
                </Link>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="hidden py-2 text-sm md:block">
          <AuthControls />
        </div>

        <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-2 md:hidden">
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">myeverything</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
            aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            aria-expanded={open}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 p-2 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              width="20"
              height="20"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            >
              {open ? (
                <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6l-12 12" />
              ) : (
                <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" />
              )}
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-black/10 px-4 py-3 md:hidden dark:border-white/10">
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {TABS.map((tab) => {
              const active = pathname === tab.href;
              return (
                <li key={tab.href}>
                  <Link
                    href={tab.href}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded px-2 py-2 text-sm font-medium ${
                      active
                        ? "bg-black/5 text-foreground dark:bg-white/10"
                        : "text-zinc-500"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {tab.label}
                    {tab.requiresAuth && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                        (login required)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </Link>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          <div className="mt-3 border-t border-black/10 pt-3 text-sm dark:border-white/10">
            <AuthControls onNavigate={() => setOpen(false)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 14:29:22Z)**_

Two real caching layers exist here: the browser's cache for the HTML document (has an ETag + `s-maxage`, ambiguous for private caches), and — the more important one — **Laravel's server-side `Cache::remember` on the 4 Market data calls** (2–5 min TTL). I found that Market's *existing* "Refresh" button doesn't actually bust that cache today; it just re-hits the same cached response. Let's fix both properly.

```typescript
function AuthControls({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: () => void }) {
  const { user, status, logout } = useAuth();

  if (status === "authenticated" && user) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-center md:gap-3">
        <span className="text-zinc-500">{user.email}</span>

            onNavigate?.();
          }}
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >

        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === "unauthenticated") {
    return (
      <Link
        href="/login"
        onClick={onNavigate}
        className="font-medium hover:underline"
      >
        Log in
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return null;
}

function hardReload() {
  // A changed query string guarantees the browser can't serve this
  // navigation from cache — location.reload() alone doesn't reliably
  // force a network fetch of the document across browsers.
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set("_refresh", Date.now().toString());
  window.location.href = url.toString();
}

function ForceRefreshButton({ label }: { label?: boolean }) {
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  async function handleClick() {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      // The only server-side response cache in this app lives in
      // MarketDataService (Cache::remember, 2-5 min TTL); bust it so the
      // reload below actually pulls fresh data instead of a stale hit.
      // Bounded so a slow/unreachable provider can't hang the button.
      await Promise.race([
        getMarketOverview(true),
        new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 3000)),
      ]);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort — still hard-reload below even if this failed.
    } finally {
      hardReload();
    }
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={refreshing}
      aria-label="Force refresh"
      title="Force refresh — bypass all caches and reload everything from the server"
      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded border border-black/10 p-2 text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-white/10"
    >

    </button>
  );
}
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 14:31:12Z)**_

Deployed and verified end-to-end. Summary:

**The button**: a circular-arrow icon in the nav bar (both desktop, next to the auth controls, and mobile, next to the hamburger) — spins while working, then does a genuine hard reload.

**What "no caching, pull everything from server" actually required**, found by checking every layer:
1. **Server-side cache** (the real one) — `MarketDataService`'s 4 `Cache::remember` calls (currencies/crypto/indices/movers, 2–5 min TTL) are the *only* server-side caching anywhere in this API. Added a `fresh` flag (`MarketController::overview` → `?fresh=1`) that calls `Cache::forget` on all four keys before recomputing. Verified live: cached requests take ~0.15–0.25s, a `fresh=1` request takes ~1.2s (genuinely re-hitting Frankfurter/CoinGecko/Yahoo).
2. **Bug found and fixed along the way**: Market's own existing "Refresh" button never actually busted this cache — it just re-requested the same (possibly still-cached) response. Now its refresh click passes `fresh=1` too (first page load still uses cache normally, only explicit refreshes bypass it).
3. **Browser HTTP cache** — checked response headers: API JSON responses already send `Cache-Control: no-cache, private` with no validator, so browsers can't serve those stale regardless. The HTML document has an ETag + `s-maxage`, which is ambiguous for private-cache behavior across browsers, so rather than trust `location.reload()` (its old force-bypass behavior is deprecated/unreliable), the button navigates to the current URL with a timestamp query param — guaranteed to never match a cache entry.
4. A full reload also naturally remounts every tab's components, so each one's own `useEffect` data-fetch re-runs from scratch regardless of tab.

Same caveat as before: no browser tool connected this session, so I verified via response headers/timing and structural HTML checks rather than a visual click-through — worth a manual test on your end.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 14:37:50Z)**_

Two realistic options, and I'd start with the cheap one: most RSS feeds already include `<category>` elements per item (near-zero cost — it's already in the XML your fetcher parses, just currently discarded), so I'd pull those into a `news_article_tag` table first and only reach for an LLM call (title + summary → a handful of tags) as a fallback for sources that don't supply categories or supply garbage ones.

The tradeoff: RSS categories are inconsistent across sources — some are specific and clean, others nonexistent or noisy (e.g. "Uncategorized") — so you won't get uniform tag quality without normalization work, whereas an LLM gives consistent quality across every source but costs a per-article API call (hundreds of articles every 15 minutes adds up) and a new dependency to manage.

Want me to plan out the RSS-category approach, or do you want LLM-based extraction from the start?

```text
19	        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);
20	
21	        if ($xml === false) {
22	            return [];
23	        }
24	
25	        if (isset($xml->channel)) {
26	            return $this->parseRss($xml);
27	        }
28	
29	        if ($xml->getName() === 'feed') {
30	            return $this->parseAtom($xml);
31	        }
32	
33	        return [];
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
38	     */
39	    private function parseRss(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
40	    {
41	        $items = [];
42	        $media = $xml->channel->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
43	
44	        foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item) {
45	            $guid = trim((string) ($item->guid ?: $item->link));
46	            $link = trim((string) $item->link);
47	            $title = trim((string) $item->title);
48	
49	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
50	                continue;
51	            }
52	
53	            $itemMedia = $item->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
54	            $imageUrl = null;
55	            if (isset($itemMedia->thumbnail)) {
56	                $imageUrl = (string) $itemMedia->thumbnail->attributes()->url;
57	            } elseif (isset($item->enclosure) && str_starts_with((string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->type, 'image/')) {
58	                $imageUrl = (string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->url;
59	            }
60	
61	            $pubDate = trim((string) $item->pubDate);
62	
63	            $items[] = [
64	                'guid' => $guid,
65	                'title' => $title,
66	                'url' => $link,
67	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $item->description) ?: null,
68	                'image_url' => $imageUrl ?: null,
69	                'published_at' => $pubDate !== '' ? $this->parseDate($pubDate) : null,
70	            ];
71	        }
72	
73	        unset($media);
74	
75	        return $items;
76	    }
77	
78	    /**
79	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
80	     */
81	    private function parseAtom(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
82	    {
83	        $items = [];
84	
85	        foreach ($xml->entry as $entry) {
86	            $guid = trim((string) $entry->id);
87	            $title = trim((string) $entry->title);
88	
89	            $link = '';
90	            foreach ($entry->link as $linkEl) {
91	                $attrs = $linkEl->attributes();
92	                if ((string) $attrs->rel === '' || (string) $attrs->rel === 'alternate') {
93	                    $link = (string) $attrs->href;
94	                    break;
95	                }
96	            }
97	
98	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
99	                continue;
100	            }
101	
102	            $published = trim((string) ($entry->published ?: $entry->updated));
103	
104	            $items[] = [
105	                'guid' => $guid,
106	                'title' => $title,
107	                'url' => $link,
108	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $entry->summary) ?: null,
109	                'image_url' => null,
110	                'published_at' => $published !== '' ? $this->parseDate($published) : null,
111	            ];
112	        }
113	
114	        return $items;
115	    }
116	
117	    private function cleanSummary(string $html): string
118	    {
119	        $text = trim(strip_tags($html));
120	
121	        return mb_strlen($text) > 500 ? mb_substr($text, 0, 497).'...' : $text;
122	    }
123	
124	    private function parseDate(string $value): ?Carbon
125	    {
126	        try {
127	            return Carbon::parse($value);
128	        } catch (\Throwable) {
129	            return null;
130	        }
131	    }
132	}
133
```

```text
36	    /**
37	     * Whether this todo has an occurrence falling on the given date.
38	     */
39	    public function isDueOn(CarbonInterface $date): bool
40	    {
41	        $date = $date->copy()->startOfDay();
42	        $start = $this->start_date->copy()->startOfDay();
43	
44	        if ($date->lt($start)) {
45	            return false;
46	        }
47	
48	        return match ($this->recurrence) {
49	            'once' => $date->equalTo($start),
50	            'daily' => true,
51	            'weekly' => $start->diffInDays($date) % 7 === 0,
52	            'custom' => $start->diffInDays($date) % max(1, (int) $this->interval_days) === 0,
53	            default => false,
54	        };
55	    }
56	}
```

**When a user applies a tag to an article, should that be private to them, or visible/shared with other users of the app?**

Options:
- **Private per-user (recommended)** - Matches how source lists and article feedback already work in this app — your tags are your own personal labels; other users don't see them and can't apply your tags.
- **Shared/global** - Any logged-in user's tag becomes visible to everyone, and anyone can apply an existing tag (not just the creator) to any article — more like a collaborative folksonomy.

**Should the RSS-derived categories (auto-extracted from each feed's <category> elements) be merged into the same tag system as user tags, or kept as separate read-only metadata?**

Options:
- **Keep separate (recommended)** - RSS categories are shown as read-only labels on an article (from the source, same for everyone). User tags are a distinct, personal system layered on top. Simpler, no ownership ambiguity.
- **Merge into one system** - RSS categories become auto-created global tags in the same table users tag with — e.g. an article auto-tagged "politics" from its feed could then be tagged "politics" by a user too, deduped into one tag.

```text
12	class TodoController extends Controller
13	{
14	    public function index(Request $request)
15	    {
16	        $todos = $request->user()->todos()->get();
17	        $today = now()->startOfDay();
18	
19	        $completedTodayIds = TodoCompletion::whereIn('todo_id', $todos->pluck('id'))
20	            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
21	            ->pluck('todo_id');
22	
23	        $todos->each(function (Todo $todo) use ($today, $completedTodayIds) {
24	            $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
25	            $todo->completed_today = $completedTodayIds->contains($todo->id);
26	        });
27	
28	        return TodoResource::collection($todos);
29	    }
30	
31	    public function store(Request $request)
32	    {
33	        $validated = $this->validated($request);
34	
35	        $nextPosition = (int) ($request->user()->todos()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;
36	
37	        $todo = $request->user()->todos()->create([
38	            ...$validated,
39	            'position' => $nextPosition,
40	        ]);
41	
42	        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn(now()->startOfDay());
43	        $todo->completed_today = false;
44	
45	        return new TodoResource($todo);
46	    }
47	
48	    public function update(Request $request, Todo $todo)
49	    {
50	        $this->authorize('update', $todo);
51	
52	        $validated = $this->validated($request);
53	        $todo->update($validated);
54	
55	        $today = now()->startOfDay();
56	        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
57	        $todo->completed_today = $todo->completions()
58	            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
59	            ->exists();
60	
61	        return new TodoResource($todo);
62	    }
63	
64	    public function destroy(Request $request, Todo $todo)
65	    {
66	        $this->authorize('delete', $todo);
67	
68	        $todo->delete();
69	
70	        return response()->noContent();
71	    }
72	
73	    public function reorder(Request $request)
74	    {
75	        $user = $request->user();
76	
77	        $validated = $request->validate([
78	            'todo_ids' => ['required', 'array'],
79	            'todo_ids.*' => ['integer'],
80	        ]);
81	
82	        $ownedIds = $user->todos()->pluck('id');
83	
84	        foreach (array_values($validated['todo_ids']) as $position => $todoId) {
85	            if (! $ownedIds->contains($todoId)) {
86	                continue;
87	            }
88	
89	            DB::table('todos')
90	                ->where('id', $todoId)
91	                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
92	                ->update(['position' => $position]);
93	        }
94	
95	        return $this->index($request);
96	    }
97	
98	    public function toggle(Request $request, Todo $todo)
99	    {
100	        $this->authorize('update', $todo);
101	
102	        $today = now()->toDateString();
103	
104	        $completion = $todo->completions()->whereDate('completed_on', $today)->first();
105	
106	        if ($completion) {
107	            $completion->delete();
108	            $completedToday = false;
109	        } else {
110	            $todo->completions()->create(['completed_on' => $today]);
111	            $completedToday = true;
112	        }
113	
114	        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn(now()->startOfDay());
115	        $todo->completed_today = $completedToday;
116	
117	        return new TodoResource($todo);
118	    }

124	            'description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
125	            'recurrence' => ['required', Rule::in(['once', 'daily', 'weekly', 'custom'])],
126	            'interval_days' => ['required_if:recurrence,custom', 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:2', 'max:365'],
127	            'start_date' => ['required', 'date'],
128	        ]);
129	    }
```

I now have everything needed. Here's the full research report.

## 1. RSS fetching pipeline

**`app/Console/Commands/FetchNewsCommand.php`** — `handle(RssParser $parser)`: loops `NewsSource::all()`, calls `fetchSource()`, which fetches the feed via `Http::timeout(10)->withUserAgent(...)->get($source->feed_url)`, calls `$parser->parse($response->body())`, then for each item does:

```php
NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(
    ['news_source_id' => $source->id, 'guid' => $item['guid']],
    [
        'title' => $item['title'],
        'url' => $item['url'],
        'summary' => $item['summary'],
        'image_url' => $item['image_url'],
        'published_at' => $item['published_at'],
    ],
);
```
This is exactly where you'd add `'categories' => $item['categories']` (or sync a pivot after `updateOrCreate` returns the model).

**`app/Services/News/RssParser.php`** — uses **SimpleXML** (`simplexml_load_string`, with `libxml_use_internal_errors(true)`), no external package. Two branches:
- `parseRss()` — reads `$xml->channel->item`: `guid` (falls back to `link`), `title`, `link`→`url`, `description`→`summary` (stripped/truncated via `cleanSummary`), image via MRSS `media:thumbnail` or `enclosure`, `pubDate`→`published_at` (parsed with `Carbon::parse`).
- `parseAtom()` — reads `$xml->entry`: `id`→`guid`, `title`, `link[rel=alternate]`→`url`, `summary`→`summary`, no image, `published`/`updated`→`published_at`.

**`<category>` elements are not touched anywhere currently.** In RSS 2.0, `<item><category>Foo</category></item>` (repeatable, plain text, occasionally has a `domain` attribute) is a sibling of `<title>`/`<link>`/`<description>` inside `foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item)` — add extraction there, e.g. `$categories = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map(fn($c) => trim((string)$c), iterator_to_array($item->category)))));`. Atom uses `<category term="Foo"/>` (attribute, not text node) inside `<entry>` — would need `(string) $catEl->attributes()->term`. Both return arrays, so the parser's return type docblock (`array{guid, title, url, summary, image_url, published_at}`) needs a `categories: array<string>` key added in both `parseRss` and `parseAtom`.

## 2. NewsArticle model & migration

Migration `database/migrations/2026_08_18_163613_create_news_articles_table.php` — table `news_articles`:
```php
$table->id();
$table->foreignId('news_source_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();
$table->string('guid');
$table->string('title');
$table->string('url', 2048);
$table->text('summary')->nullable();
$table->string('image_url', 2048)->nullable();
$table->timestamp('published_at')->nullable();
$table->timestamps();
$table->unique(['news_source_id', 'guid']);
$table->index('published_at');
```

Model `app/Models/NewsArticle.php`:
```php
#[Fillable(['news_source_id', 'guid', 'title', 'url', 'summary', 'image_url', 'published_at'])]
class NewsArticle extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
    protected function casts(): array { return ['published_at' => 'datetime']; }
    public function source(): BelongsTo { return $this->belongsTo(NewsSource::class, 'news_source_id'); }
    public function feedback(): HasMany { return $this->hasMany(NewsArticleFeedback::class); }
}
```
No `categories`/`tags` relation exists yet. Note: uses the `#[Fillable(...)]` PHP attribute (not `protected $fillable`) — follow that convention for new models.

## 3. Todo pattern (per-user-owned CRUD reference)

**Migration** `database/migrations/2026_08_18_192505_create_todos_table.php`: `foreignId('user_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete()`, plus fields, `index(['user_id', 'position'])`.

**Model** `app/Models/Todo.php`: `#[Fillable([...])]` attribute; `belongsTo(User::class)` as `user()`; `hasMany(TodoCompletion::class)` as `completions()`.

**`User::todos()`** in `app/Models/User.php`: `return $this->hasMany(Todo::class)->orderBy('position');` — simple `hasMany`, no pivot.

**Policy** `app/Policies/TodoPolicy.php` — minimal, only `update`/`delete` (ownership check by id comparison), no `create`/`view` methods needed since creation is scoped via `$request->user()->todos()->create()`:
```php
class TodoPolicy {
    public function update(User $user, Todo $todo): bool { return $user->id === $todo->user_id; }
    public function delete(User $user, Todo $todo): bool { return $user->id === $todo->user_id; }
}
```
No explicit policy registration found in `app/Providers/` (`AppServiceProvider.php`, `SsoServiceProvider.php`) — relies on Laravel's policy auto-discovery by naming convention (`App\Models\Todo` → `App\Policies\TodoPolicy`). New `Tag`/`ArticleTag` policies should follow the same auto-discovered naming.

**Controller** `app/Http/Controllers/TodoController.php` — conventions:
- `index`: `$request->user()->todos()->get()`, decorates with computed (non-persisted) attributes.
- `store`: `$request->user()->todos()->create([...$validated])` (scoped creation, no manual `user_id`).
- `update`/`destroy`/`toggle`: `$this->authorize('update'|'delete', $todo)` then act, `destroy` returns `response()->noContent()`.
- Validation is inlined via a private `validated(Request $request): array` helper using `$request->validate([...])`, with `Rule::in([...])` for enums.
- Response shaping via `new TodoResource($todo)` / `TodoResource::collection($todos)`.

**`app/Http/Resources/TodoResource.php`** — plain `JsonResource` with explicit `toArray()` field list (no auto-magic passthrough).

**Routes** in `routes/api.php` — todos group:
```php
Route::middleware('auth:sanctum')->prefix('todos')->group(function () {
    Route::get('/', [TodoController::class, 'index']);
    Route::post('/', [TodoController::class, 'store']);
    Route::patch('/reorder', [TodoController::class, 'reorder']);
    Route::patch('/{todo}', [TodoController::class, 'update']);
    Route::delete('/{todo}', [TodoController::class, 'destroy']);
    Route::post('/{todo}/toggle', [TodoController::class, 'toggle']);
});
```

## 4. NewsArticleFeedback (closest precedent for per-user data tied to articles)

Migration `database/migrations/2026_08_18_163614_create_news_article_feedback_table.php` — table `news_article_feedback`:
```php
$table->id();
$table->foreignId('user_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();
$table->foreignId('news_article_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();
$table->foreignId('news_source_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();
$table->smallInteger('direction');
$table->timestamps();
$table->unique(['user_id', 'news_article_id']);
$table->index(['user_id', 'news_source_id']);
```
Model `app/Models/NewsArticleFeedback.php`: `#[Fillable(['user_id', 'news_article_id', 'news_source_id', 'direction'])]`, `belongsTo` to `User`, `NewsArticle` (as `article()`), `NewsSource` (as `source()`). No dedicated policy — ownership is enforced manually inside the controller (`app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedbackController.php`) by filtering `where('user_id', $request->user()->id)` rather than route-model-binding + `authorize()`. This is the pattern to mirror for a user-tag-on-article join table, e.g. a future `article_tag` pivot with `user_id`, `news_article_id`, `tag_id` and a unique constraint.

`FeedbackController::store()` uses `updateOrCreate(['user_id'=>..., 'news_article_id'=>...], [...])`; `destroy()` does a scoped `where(...)->delete()`. Routes are nested under the article and require auth:
```php
Route::post('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'store']);
Route::delete('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'destroy']);
```

## 5. `routes/api.php` news group (full structure)

```php
Route::prefix('news')->group(function () {
    Route::get('/sources', [SourceController::class, 'index']);   // public
    Route::get('/feed', [FeedController::class, 'index']);        // public

    Route::middleware('auth:sanctum')->group(function () {
        Route::post('/sources', [SourceController::class, 'store']);
        Route::delete('/sources/{source}', [SourceController::class, 'destroy']);
        Route::patch('/sources/reorder', [SourceController::class, 'reorder']);
        Route::post('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'store']);
        Route::delete('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'destroy']);
    });
});
```
Controllers live under `app/Http/Controllers/News/` namespace `App\Http\Controllers\News`. A new tagging feature should add e.g. `App\Http\Controllers\News\TagController` and nest routes similarly: `GET /news/tags` (public, list all/global tags or user's tags), and inside the `auth:sanctum` inner group: `POST /news/tags`, `DELETE /news/tags/{tag}`, `POST /news/articles/{article}/tags`, `DELETE /news/articles/{article}/tags/{tag}`.

Also relevant: `app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedController.php` (`index`) shows how `NewsArticle` records get decorated with computed per-viewer fields (`viewer_feedback`) via `DB::table('news_article_feedback')` lookups keyed by `$user->id`/article id, then exposed in `app/Http/Resources/NewsArticleResource.php` via `$this->when($this->viewer_feedback !== null, ...)`. The same `when()`-conditional-field pattern in the resource, and bulk `DB::table` pivot lookups in `FeedController::index`, is the template for exposing per-user applied tags on each article in the feed response without an N+1 query per article.

**Existing `app/Policies/` directory** also has `BrainiacAttemptPolicy.php`, `GigLeadPolicy.php`, `ResumePolicy.php` alongside `TodoPolicy.php` — all simple, single/two-method ownership-check classes; worth a quick look for further consistency but `TodoPolicy` is representative.

Design a detailed, execution-ready implementation plan for a news article tagging feature in a Laravel 13 API + Next.js frontend personal dashboard app at /var/www/jepflow.io/public/myeverything (api/ = Laravel, web/ = Next.js). This is planning only — do not write any code or modify any files.

## Confirmed product decisions (already agreed with the user, do not re-litigate):
1. Tags are a SHARED/GLOBAL system: any logged-in user can create a tag, apply an existing tag to any article, and delete any tag (removes it everywhere, for everyone). Not private per-user.
2. RSS-derived categories (auto-extracted from each feed item's `<category>` elements during the scheduled fetch) are merged into the SAME shared tag table as user-created tags — e.g. if RSS auto-creates a "politics" tag and a user later creates/applies "politics", they resolve to the same tag row (case-insensitive dedup by name; MySQL 8's default collation is case-insensitive so a plain unique constraint on `name` should suffice for this — verify this assumption is safe, or recommend a normalized column instead if there's a reason not to rely on it).
3. Two distinct actions: "apply/detach" a tag on ONE article (low-risk, per-article join removal) vs. "delete" a tag entirely (global, removes it from every article for every user). Both should exist.

## Existing codebase conventions to follow exactly (from prior research, verified accurate):

**RSS fetch pipeline:**
- `app/Console/Commands/FetchNewsCommand.php`: loops sources, fetches each via `Http`, calls `RssParser::parse($body)`, then for each item does `NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(['news_source_id'=>..., 'guid'=>...], ['title'=>..., 'url'=>..., 'summary'=>..., 'image_url'=>..., 'published_at'=>...])`. This is where category-tag attachment logic should be added, right after each article is upserted.
- `app/Services/News/RssParser.php`: uses SimpleXML (not a package). `parseRss()` reads `$xml->channel->item` (RSS 2.0: `<category>Foo</category>` is a repeatable plain-text sibling element of `<title>`/`<link>`/`<description>` inside `<item>`). `parseAtom()` reads `$xml->entry` (Atom: `<category term="Foo"/>` — value is in the `term` attribute, not text). Both currently return an array per item with keys guid/title/url/summary/image_url/published_at and need a new `categories: array<string>` key added to both branches.

**NewsArticle model/migration (current, no tags yet):**
- Migration: `id, news_source_id (FK cascade), guid, title, url (2048), summary (nullable text), image_url (nullable, 2048), published_at (nullable), timestamps; unique(source_id,guid); index(published_at)`.
- Model: `#[Fillable(['news_source_id','guid','title','url','summary','image_url','published_at'])]` attribute-based fillable (NOT `protected $fillable` — this codebase's convention), `HasFactory`, `source(): BelongsTo`, `feedback(): HasMany`.

**Per-user-owned CRUD pattern (Todo, as the reference for a full "user creates/owns/deletes a first-class resource" flow):**
- Migration: `foreignId('user_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete()`.
- Model: `#[Fillable([...])]`, `belongsTo(User::class)` as `user()`.
- `User::todos(): HasMany` — simple relation added to `app/Models/User.php`.
- Policy `app/Policies/TodoPolicy.php`: minimal, just `update`/`delete` ownership checks (`$user->id === $todo->user_id`), no explicit registration anywhere — relies on Laravel's naming-convention auto-discovery (`App\Models\X` → `App\Policies\XPolicy`).
- Controller: creation via `$request->user()->todos()->create([...$validated])`; mutations via `$this->authorize('update'|'delete', $model)` then act; `destroy` returns `response()->noContent()`; validation inlined via a private `validated(Request $request): array` helper method using `$request->validate([...])`.

- Routes nested under the article: `POST /news/articles/{article}/feedback`, `DELETE /news/articles/{article}/feedback`, both behind `auth:sanctum`.

**Current `routes/api.php` news group (full, verbatim):**
```php

    Route::get('/sources', [SourceController::class, 'index']);   // public
    Route::get('/feed', [FeedController::class, 'index']);        // public
```

Controllers live under `app/Http/Controllers/News/` (namespace `App\Http\Controllers\News`).

**`FeedController::index()` (app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedController.php)** already demonstrates the pattern for decorating a list of `NewsArticle` results with per-viewer computed data without N+1 queries: it bulk-loads `news_article_feedback` rows via `DB::table(...)->whereIn('news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))->pluck(...)`, then sets a non-persisted `viewer_feedback` property per article in a loop, which `NewsArticleResource` exposes via `$this->when($this->viewer_feedback !== null, ...)`. **`SourceController::store()`** demonstrates accepting EITHER an existing-resource ID OR inline-creation-by-name in a single endpoint (`news_source_id` OR `name`+`feed_url`), via `firstOrCreate`. This is the pattern to mirror for "apply a tag by existing tag_id OR by name (create-if-missing)" in one endpoint.

```text
--- FetchNewsCommand ---
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsSource;
use App\Services\News\RssParser;
use App\Support\HostSafety;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Description;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Signature;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

#[Signature('news:fetch')]
#[Description('Fetch the latest articles for every news source')]
class FetchNewsCommand extends Command
{
    public function handle(RssParser $parser): int
    {
        $sources = NewsSource::all();

        foreach ($sources as $source) {
            $this->fetchSource($source, $parser);
        }

        NewsArticle::where('published_at', '<', now()->subDays(30))->delete();

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function fetchSource(NewsSource $source, RssParser $parser): void
    {
        if (! HostSafety::isSafeFeedUrl($source->feed_url)) {
            $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => 'Feed URL is not a public http(s) host.']);
            $this->error("Skipping {$source->name}: unsafe feed URL");

            return;
        }

        try {
            $response = Http::timeout(10)
                ->withUserAgent('myeverything-dashboard/1.0')
                ->get($source->feed_url);

            if (! $response->successful()) {
                $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => "HTTP {$response->status()}"]);
                $this->error("Failed to fetch {$source->name}: HTTP {$response->status()}");

                return;
            }

            $items = $parser->parse($response->body());

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(
                    ['news_source_id' => $source->id, 'guid' => $item['guid']],
                    [
                        'title' => $item['title'],
                        'url' => $item['url'],
                        'summary' => $item['summary'],
                        'image_url' => $item['image_url'],
                        'published_at' => $item['published_at'],
                    ],
                );
            }

            $source->update(['last_fetched_at' => now(), 'last_fetch_error' => null]);
            $this->info("Fetched {$source->name}: ".count($items).' items');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            $this->error("Failed to fetch {$source->name}: {$e->getMessage()}");
        }
    }
}
--- RssParser ---
<?php

namespace App\Services\News;

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use SimpleXMLElement;

class RssParser
{
    /**
     * Parse an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed body into a normalized list of items.
     *
     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
     */
    public function parse(string $body): array
    {
        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $xml = simplexml_load_string($body);
        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);

        if ($xml === false) {
            return [];
        }

        if (isset($xml->channel)) {
            return $this->parseRss($xml);
        }

        if ($xml->getName() === 'feed') {
            return $this->parseAtom($xml);
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
     */
    private function parseRss(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
    {
        $items = [];
        $media = $xml->channel->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');

        foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item) {
            $guid = trim((string) ($item->guid ?: $item->link));
            $link = trim((string) $item->link);
            $title = trim((string) $item->title);

            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $itemMedia = $item->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
            $imageUrl = null;
            if (isset($itemMedia->thumbnail)) {
                $imageUrl = (string) $itemMedia->thumbnail->attributes()->url;
            } elseif (isset($item->enclosure) && str_starts_with((string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->type, 'image/')) {
                $imageUrl = (string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->url;
            }

            $pubDate = trim((string) $item->pubDate);

            $items[] = [
                'guid' => $guid,
                'title' => $title,
                'url' => $link,
                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $item->description) ?: null,
                'image_url' => $imageUrl ?: null,
                'published_at' => $pubDate !== '' ? $this->parseDate($pubDate) : null,
            ];
        }

        unset($media);

        return $items;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
     */
    private function parseAtom(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
    {
        $items = [];

        foreach ($xml->entry as $entry) {
            $guid = trim((string) $entry->id);
            $title = trim((string) $entry->title);

            $link = '';
            foreach ($entry->link as $linkEl) {
                $attrs = $linkEl->attributes();
                if ((string) $attrs->rel === '' || (string) $attrs->rel === 'alternate') {
                    $link = (string) $attrs->href;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $published = trim((string) ($entry->published ?: $entry->updated));

            $items[] = [
                'guid' => $guid,
                'title' => $title,
                'url' => $link,
                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $entry->summary) ?: null,
                'image_url' => null,
                'published_at' => $published !== '' ? $this->parseDate($published) : null,
            ];
        }

        return $items;
    }

    private function cleanSummary(string $html): string
    {
        $text = trim(strip_tags($html));

        return mb_strlen($text) > 500 ? mb_substr($text, 0, 497).'...' : $text;
    }

    private function parseDate(string $value): ?Carbon
    {
        try {
            return Carbon::parse($value);
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```text
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\NewsArticleResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsSource;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class FeedController extends Controller
{
    /** Each point of source affinity shifts an article's effective recency by this many hours. */
    private const AFFINITY_HOURS = 6;

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $limit = min((int) $request->integer('limit', 50), 100);
        $query = trim((string) $request->string('q'));
        $topic = trim((string) $request->string('topic'));

        $sources = $user
            ? $user->newsSources()
            : NewsSource::where('is_default', true);

        if ($topic !== '') {
            $sources->where('topic', $topic);
        }

        $sourceIds = $user ? $sources->pluck('news_sources.id') : $sources->pluck('id');

        if ($sourceIds->isEmpty()) {
            return NewsArticleResource::collection(collect());
        }

        $articlesQuery = NewsArticle::with('source')
            ->whereIn('news_source_id', $sourceIds);

        if ($query !== '') {
            $escaped = str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $query);
            $articlesQuery->where(function ($inner) use ($escaped) {
                $inner->where('title', 'like', "%{$escaped}%")
                    ->orWhere('summary', 'like', "%{$escaped}%");
            });
        }

        $articles = $articlesQuery
            ->orderByDesc('published_at')
            ->limit(300)
            ->get();

        $affinity = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->select('news_source_id', DB::raw('SUM(direction) as score'))
                ->groupBy('news_source_id')
                ->pluck('score', 'news_source_id')
            : collect();

        $viewerFeedback = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->whereIn('news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))
                ->pluck('direction', 'news_article_id')
            : collect();

        $articles = $articles
            ->sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($affinity) {
                $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
                $boost = (int) ($affinity->get($article->news_source_id) ?? 0);

                return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
            })
            ->values()
            ->take($limit);

        $articles->each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($viewerFeedback) {
            $article->viewer_feedback = $viewerFeedback->has($article->id)
                ? (int) $viewerFeedback->get($article->id)
                : null;
        });

        return NewsArticleResource::collection($articles);
    }
}
```

```text
namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsArticleFeedback;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class FeedbackController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'direction' => ['required', 'integer', 'in:1,-1'],
        ]);

        NewsArticleFeedback::updateOrCreate(
            ['user_id' => $request->user()->id, 'news_article_id' => $article->id],
            ['news_source_id' => $article->news_source_id, 'direction' => $validated['direction']],
        );

        return response()->json(['direction' => $validated['direction']]);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        NewsArticleFeedback::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->where('news_article_id', $article->id)
            ->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
```

```text
--- Todo model ---
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

#[Fillable(['title', 'description', 'recurrence', 'interval_days', 'start_date', 'position'])]
class Todo extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<\Database\Factories\TodoFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'start_date' => 'date',
            'interval_days' => 'integer',
        ];
    }

    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function completions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TodoCompletion::class);
    }

    /**
     * Whether this todo has an occurrence falling on the given date.
     */
    public function isDueOn(CarbonInterface $date): bool
    {
        $date = $date->copy()->startOfDay();
        $start = $this->start_date->copy()->startOfDay();

        if ($date->lt($start)) {
            return false;
        }

        return match ($this->recurrence) {
            'once' => $date->equalTo($start),
            'daily' => true,
            'weekly' => $start->diffInDays($date) % 7 === 0,
            'custom' => $start->diffInDays($date) % max(1, (int) $this->interval_days) === 0,
            default => false,
        };
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Resources\TodoResource;
use App\Models\Todo;
use App\Models\TodoCompletion;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class TodoController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $todos = $request->user()->todos()->get();
        $today = now()->startOfDay();

        $completedTodayIds = TodoCompletion::whereIn('todo_id', $todos->pluck('id'))
            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
            ->pluck('todo_id');

        $todos->each(function (Todo $todo) use ($today, $completedTodayIds) {
            $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
            $todo->completed_today = $completedTodayIds->contains($todo->id);
        });

        return TodoResource::collection($todos);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validated($request);

        $nextPosition = (int) ($request->user()->todos()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;

        $todo = $request->user()->todos()->create([
            ...$validated,
            'position' => $nextPosition,
        ]);

        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn(now()->startOfDay());
        $todo->completed_today = false;

        return new TodoResource($todo);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Todo $todo)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $todo);

        $validated = $this->validated($request);
        $todo->update($validated);

        $today = now()->startOfDay();
        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
        $todo->completed_today = $todo->completions()
            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
            ->exists();

        return new TodoResource($todo);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, Todo $todo)
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $todo);

        $todo->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function reorder(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'todo_ids' => ['required', 'array'],
            'todo_ids.*' => ['integer'],
        ]);

        $ownedIds = $user->todos()->pluck('id');

        foreach (array_values($validated['todo_ids']) as $position => $todoId) {
            if (! $ownedIds->contains($todoId)) {
                continue;
            }

            DB::table('todos')
                ->where('id', $todoId)
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->update(['position' => $position]);
        }

        return $this->index($request);
    }

    public function toggle(Request $request, Todo $todo)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $todo);

        $today = now()->toDateString();

        $completion = $todo->completions()->whereDate('completed_on', $today)->first();

        if ($completion) {
            $completion->delete();
            $completedToday = false;
        } else {
            $todo->completions()->create(['completed_on' => $today]);
            $completedToday = true;
        }

        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn(now()->startOfDay());
        $todo->completed_today = $completedToday;

        return new TodoResource($todo);
    }

    private function validated(Request $request): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'description' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'recurrence' => ['required', Rule::in(['once', 'daily', 'weekly', 'custom'])],
            'interval_days' => ['required_if:recurrence,custom', 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:2', 'max:365'],
            'start_date' => ['required', 'date'],
        ]);
    }
}
```
