```text
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\NewsSourceResource;
use App\Models\NewsSource;
use App\Rules\SafeFeedUrl;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class SourceController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $sources = NewsSource::orderBy('name')->get();

        $positions = $request->user()
            ? DB::table('news_source_user')
                ->where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
                ->pluck('position', 'news_source_id')
            : collect();

        $sources->each(function (NewsSource $source) use ($positions) {
            $source->added_position = $positions->has($source->id) ? (int) $positions->get($source->id) : null;
        });

        return NewsSourceResource::collection($sources);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'news_source_id' => ['required_without:feed_url', 'integer', 'exists:news_sources,id'],
            'name' => ['required_with:feed_url', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'feed_url' => ['required_without:news_source_id', 'url', 'max:2048', new SafeFeedUrl],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['news_source_id'])) {
            $source = NewsSource::findOrFail($validated['news_source_id']);
        } else {
            $source = NewsSource::firstOrCreate(
                ['feed_url' => $validated['feed_url']],
                [
                    'name' => $validated['name'],
                    'site_url' => $validated['feed_url'],
                ],
            );
            // is_default isn't mass-assignable (kept off the model's fillable
            // list so it can never be set from request input); the DB column
            // default (false) applies on insert, but refresh so the in-memory
            // model reflects it instead of showing null on this response.
            $source->refresh();
        }

        if (! $user->newsSources()->where('news_sources.id', $source->id)->exists()) {
            $nextPosition = (int) ($user->newsSources()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;
            $user->newsSources()->attach($source->id, ['position' => $nextPosition]);
        }

        $source->added_position = $user->newsSources()
            ->where('news_sources.id', $source->id)
            ->value('position');

        return new NewsSourceResource($source);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, NewsSource $source)
    {
        $request->user()->newsSources()->detach($source->id);

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function reorder(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'source_ids' => ['required', 'array'],
            'source_ids.*' => ['integer'],
        ]);

        $ownedIds = $user->newsSources()->pluck('news_sources.id');

        foreach (array_values($validated['source_ids']) as $position => $sourceId) {
            if (! $ownedIds->contains($sourceId)) {
                continue;
            }

            DB::table('news_source_user')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->where('news_source_id', $sourceId)
                ->update(['position' => $position]);
        }

        return $this->index($request);
    }
}
```

```text
import { apiFetch } from "./api";
import type { NewsArticle, NewsSource } from "./news-types";

export async function getSources(): Promise<NewsSource[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource[] }>("/api/news/sources");
  return res.data;
}

export async function getFeed(
  limit = 50,
  q = "",
  topic = "",
): Promise<NewsArticle[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  if (q.trim() !== "") params.set("q", q.trim());
  if (topic.trim() !== "") params.set("topic", topic.trim());
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsArticle[] }>(
    `/api/news/feed?${params.toString()}`,
  );
  return res.data;
}

export async function addExistingSource(
  newsSourceId: number,
): Promise<NewsSource> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource }>("/api/news/sources", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { news_source_id: newsSourceId },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export async function addCustomSource(
  name: string,
  feedUrl: string,
): Promise<NewsSource> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource }>("/api/news/sources", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { name, feed_url: feedUrl },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export function removeSource(sourceId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/sources/${sourceId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function reorderSources(
  sourceIds: number[],
): Promise<NewsSource[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource[] }>(
    "/api/news/sources/reorder",
    { method: "PATCH", body: { source_ids: sourceIds } },
  );
  return res.data;
}

export function sendArticleFeedback(
  articleId: number,
  direction: 1 | -1,
): Promise<{ direction: 1 | -1 }> {
  return apiFetch(`/api/news/articles/${articleId}/feedback`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: { direction },
  });
}

export function clearArticleFeedback(articleId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/articles/${articleId}/feedback`, {
    method: "DELETE",
  });
}

export const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  data: unknown;

  constructor(status: number, data: unknown) {
    super(`API error ${status}`);
    this.status = status;
    this.data = data;
  }
}

function readCookie(name: string): string | undefined {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return undefined;
  const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${name}=([^;]*)`));
  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : undefined;
}

async function ensureCsrfCookie(): Promise<void> {
  await fetch(`${API_URL}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`, { credentials: "include" });
}

type ApiFetchOptions = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown };

export async function apiFetch<T>(
  path: string,
  options: ApiFetchOptions = {},
): Promise<T> {
  const method = (options.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();

  if (method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD") {
    await ensureCsrfCookie();
  }

  const isFormData = options.body instanceof FormData;

  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
  if (options.body !== undefined && !isFormData) {
    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
  }
  const xsrfToken = readCookie("XSRF-TOKEN");
  if (xsrfToken) {
    headers.set("X-XSRF-TOKEN", xsrfToken);
  }

  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    method,
    headers,
    credentials: "include",
    body: isFormData
      ? (options.body as FormData)
      : options.body !== undefined
        ? JSON.stringify(options.body)
        : undefined,
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    throw new ApiError(res.status, data);
  }

  if (res.status === 204) {
    return undefined as T;
  }

  return (await res.json()) as T;
}
```

```text
import type { NewsArticle } from "@/lib/news-types";

function formatPublished(published_at: string | null): string {
  if (!published_at) return "";
  const date = new Date(published_at);
  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / 3_600_000);

  if (diffHours < 1) return "just now";
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  return `${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import type { NewsSource } from "@/lib/news-types";

export function SourceManager({
  addedSources,
  catalogSources,
  canManage,
  onAddExisting,
  onAddCustom,
  onRemove,
  onReorder,
}: {
  addedSources: NewsSource[];
  catalogSources: NewsSource[];
  canManage: boolean;
  onAddExisting: (sourceId: number) => Promise<void>;
  onAddCustom: (name: string, feedUrl: string) => Promise<void>;
  onRemove: (sourceId: number) => Promise<void>;
  onReorder: (sourceIds: number[]) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [customName, setCustomName] = useState("");
  const [customFeedUrl, setCustomFeedUrl] = useState("");
  const [customError, setCustomError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (!canManage) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 text-sm dark:border-white/10">
        <p className="mb-1 font-medium">Sources</p>
        <ul className="mb-3 text-zinc-500">
          {addedSources.map((s) => (
            <li key={s.id}>{s.name}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <Link href="/login" className="text-sm font-medium underline">
          Log in to customize your sources
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  function move(index: number, delta: number) {
    const next = [...addedSources];
    const target = index + delta;
    if (target < 0 || target >= next.length) return;
    [next[index], next[target]] = [next[target], next[index]];
    onReorder(next.map((s) => s.id));
  }

  async function handleAddCustom(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setCustomError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onAddCustom(customName, customFeedUrl);
      setCustomName("");
      setCustomFeedUrl("");
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError) {
        const message =
          typeof err.data === "object" && err.data && "message" in err.data
            ? String((err.data as { message: unknown }).message)
            : "Couldn't add that source.";
        setCustomError(message);
      } else {
        setCustomError("Couldn't add that source.");
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10">
        <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Your sources</p>
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {addedSources.map((source, index) => (
            <li
              key={source.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
            >
              <span>{source.name}</span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={`Move ${source.name} up`}
                  disabled={index === 0}
                  onClick={() => move(index, -1)}
                  className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  ↑
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={`Move ${source.name} down`}
                  disabled={index === addedSources.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => move(index, 1)}
                  className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  ↓
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={`Remove ${source.name}`}
                  onClick={() => onRemove(source.id)}
                  className="ml-1 text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-600"
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {addedSources.length === 0 && (
            <li className="text-sm text-zinc-500">No sources added.</li>
          )}
        </ul>
      </div>

      {catalogSources.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10">
          <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Add a source</p>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {catalogSources.map((source) => (
              <li
                key={source.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
              >
                <span>{source.name}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onAddExisting(source.id)}
                  className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground"
                >
                  Add
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      <form
        onSubmit={handleAddCustom}
        className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10"
      >
        <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">Add a custom RSS source</p>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Name"
            required
            value={customName}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomName(e.target.value)}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm dark:border-white/10"
          />
          <input
            type="url"
            placeholder="Feed URL"
            required
            value={customFeedUrl}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomFeedUrl(e.target.value)}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm dark:border-white/10"
          />
          {customError && (
            <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{customError}</p>
          )}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="self-start rounded bg-foreground px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-background disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            Add source
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import {
  addCustomSource,
  addExistingSource,
  clearArticleFeedback,
  getFeed,
  getSources,
  removeSource,
  reorderSources,
  sendArticleFeedback,
} from "@/lib/news";
import { NEWS_TOPICS, type NewsArticle, type NewsSource } from "@/lib/news-types";
import {
  addRecentSearch,
  clearRecentSearches,
  getRecentSearches,
} from "@/lib/recent-searches";
import { ArticleCard } from "./article-card";
import { NewsSearch } from "./news-search";
import { SourceManager } from "./source-manager";

export function NewsFeed() {
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const [sources, setSources] = useState<NewsSource[]>([]);
  const [articles, setArticles] = useState<NewsArticle[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [requestId, setRequestId] = useState(0);
  const [resolvedId, setResolvedId] = useState(-1);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [recentSearches, setRecentSearches] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState("");
  const loading = requestId !== resolvedId;

  useEffect(() => {
    setRecentSearches(getRecentSearches());
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === "loading") return;

    let ignore = false;

    Promise.all([getSources(), getFeed(50, searchQuery, topic)])
      .then(([sourcesData, articlesData]) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        setSources(sourcesData);
        setArticles(articlesData);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!ignore) setError("Couldn't load the news feed.");
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!ignore) setResolvedId(requestId);
      });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, [status, requestId, searchQuery, topic]);

  function reload() {
    setRequestId((n) => n + 1);
  }

  function handleSearch(topic: string) {
    const trimmed = topic.trim();
    if (trimmed !== "") setRecentSearches(addRecentSearch(trimmed));
    setSearchQuery(trimmed);
  }

  function handleClearSearch() {
    setSearchQuery("");
  }

  function handleClearRecent() {
    setRecentSearches(clearRecentSearches());
  }

  async function handleAddExisting(sourceId: number) {
    await addExistingSource(sourceId);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleAddCustom(name: string, feedUrl: string) {
    await addCustomSource(name, feedUrl);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleRemove(sourceId: number) {
    await removeSource(sourceId);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleReorder(sourceIds: number[]) {
    const updated = await reorderSources(sourceIds);
    setSources(updated);
  }

  async function handleFeedback(articleId: number, direction: 1 | -1) {
    const article = articles.find((a) => a.id === articleId);
    if (article?.feedback === direction) {
      await clearArticleFeedback(articleId);
    } else {
      await sendArticleFeedback(articleId, direction);
    }
    reload();
  }

  const addedSources = sources.filter((s) => s.is_added);
  const catalogSources = sources.filter((s) => !s.is_added);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row">
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">News Feed</h1>
        <div className="mb-4 flex gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTopic("")}
            className={`rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium ${
              topic === ""
                ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                : "border border-black/10 text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
            }`}
          >
            All
          </button>
          {NEWS_TOPICS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTopic(t.value)}
              className={`rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium ${
                topic === t.value
                  ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                  : "border border-black/10 text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <NewsSearch
          query={searchQuery}
          recentSearches={recentSearches}
          onSearch={handleSearch}
          onClear={handleClearSearch}
          onClearRecent={handleClearRecent}
        />
        {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        {loading ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading...</p>
        ) : articles.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {searchQuery
              ? `No articles matching "${searchQuery}".`
              : "No articles yet."}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            {articles.map((article) => (
              <ArticleCard
                key={article.id}
                article={article}
                canRate={status === "authenticated"}
                onFeedback={handleFeedback}
              />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="w-full lg:w-72 lg:flex-shrink-0">
        {!loading && (
          <SourceManager
            addedSources={addedSources}
            catalogSources={catalogSources}
            canManage={status === "authenticated"}
            onAddExisting={handleAddExisting}
            onAddCustom={handleAddCustom}
            onRemove={handleRemove}
            onReorder={handleReorder}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Implementation Plan: News Article Tagging (Shared/Global Tags)

## 0. Design judgment calls (flagging up front)

1. **Uniqueness strategy for `tags.name`**: Verified — `config/database.php` defaults to `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` and the live MySQL is 8.0.46 (Ubuntu). `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` is case-insensitive and accent-sensitive-ish but for this purpose the key point is case folding: `'Politics'` and `'politics'` collide under a plain unique index on that column. A plain `$table->string('name')->unique()` is safe and sufficient — **no normalized/lowercase column needed**. Decision: store `name` exactly as first submitted (preserve casing of whoever created it first — RSS category text or user input), rely on the unique index + `firstOrCreate`/`upsert`-style lookups being done with the incoming value directly (MySQL's collation handles the case-insensitive match at the DB level, so `Tag::where('name', $value)->first()` will still find `'Politics'` when searching for `'politics'`). Trim whitespace before lookup/insert. Cap `name` length (`max:50`) to keep pills UI-friendly.
2. **Race condition on concurrent create**: `firstOrCreate` isn't atomic against a unique constraint under high concurrency; wrap tag resolution in a try/catch for `QueryException` (duplicate key) and re-fetch, OR simply rely on Laravel's `firstOrCreate` which already does a create-then-catch-unique-violation-then-refetch pattern internally as of modern Laravel — no extra code needed, just note it.
3. **Tag `destroy`**: no policy/ownership check at all (any authenticated user may delete any tag) — this is intentional per product decision #1, must be documented via a comment in the controller, not silently omitted.
4. **RSS additive-only tagging**: fetch command must only ever `attach` (never `sync`/`detach`) category-derived tags, so it never fights a user's manual detach or a user-applied tag.
5. **Attribution column** `applied_by_user_id` nullable, `nullOnDelete()` — null means system/RSS-applied; the RSS pipeline explicitly passes no user id (or a pivot row with `applied_by_user_id => null`).
6. **`attach` idempotency for both RSS and user action**: pivot has `unique(news_article_id, tag_id)` so re-attaching is a no-op; use `attach()` guarded by an `wherePivot` existence check, or wrap in try/catch for duplicate-key, or use `syncWithoutDetaching` for a single tag (simplest — `$article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id])`, but this does NOT let us set `applied_by_user_id` per-row cleanly since sync doesn't set pivot attributes unless passed). Use `$article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $userId]])` — this both handles idempotency and sets pivot attributes on insert. Note: `syncWithoutDetaching` will *update* pivot columns on existing rows too (it re-writes attributes for kept ids) — that's fine here (harmless overwrite with the same/newer attribution) but call this out.

## 4. Backend: FetchNewsCommand changes

`app/Console/Commands/FetchNewsCommand.php`, inside `fetchSource()`'s `foreach ($items as $item)` loop, right after the `updateOrCreate` call:

New private method:
```php
private function attachCategoryTags(NewsArticle $article, array $categories): void
{
    foreach ($categories as $category) {
        $name = trim($category);
        if ($name === '' || mb_strlen($name) > 50) {
            continue;
        }

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => $name]);

        $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => null]]);
    }
}
```
Note `applied_by_user_id => null` is safe/idempotent even on repeated runs — it does not clobber a user's own attribution to `null` in the common case, because if a user later independently applies the *same* tag via the `attach` endpoint, that call runs `syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $userId]])` and correctly overwrites to the user's id; the RSS pass then re-running would overwrite back to `null` on the next fetch. This is an acceptable, documented edge case (attribution is best-effort/cosmetic only, not used for any authorization) — call this out explicitly in a code comment in `attachCategoryTags()` so it isn't mistaken for a bug later. Add `use App\Models\Tag;` import.

This is additive-only: no `sync()`/`detach()` call ever removes a tag based on feed content, satisfying requirement 4.

## 5. Backend: Controller `app/Http/Controllers/News/TagController.php` (new)

```php
namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\TagResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\Tag;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $tags = Tag::orderBy('name')->get();

        $counts = DB::table('news_article_tag')
            ->select('tag_id', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as usage_count'))
            ->groupBy('tag_id')
            ->pluck('usage_count', 'tag_id');

        $tags->each(function (Tag $tag) use ($counts) {
            $tag->usage_count = (int) ($counts->get($tag->id) ?? 0);
        });

        return TagResource::collection($tags);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
        $tag->usage_count = $tag->articles()->count();

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    // No policy/authorize() call here by design: tags are a shared/global
    // resource with no ownership concept, so any authenticated user may
    // delete any tag entirely (removes it from every article, for every
    // user) — see product decision, not an oversight.
    public function destroy(Request $request, Tag $tag)
    {
        $tag->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tag_id' => ['required_without:name', 'integer', 'exists:tags,id'],
            'name' => ['required_without:tag_id', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['tag_id'])) {
            $tag = Tag::findOrFail($validated['tag_id']);
        } else {
            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
        }

        $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id],
        ]);

        $tag->usage_count = $tag->articles()->count();

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    public function detach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)
    {
        $article->tags()->detach($tag->id);

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}
```
Notes:
- `attach`/`detach` mirror `SourceController::store`'s "existing id OR name" pattern and `FeedbackController`'s per-article scoping style (route-model-bound `{article}`).
- No `TagPolicy` file — deliberately absent, matching the note that ownership-style policies don't fit a global resource; only `auth:sanctum` middleware gates writes, exactly as `FeedbackController` relies on manual `where('user_id', ...)` scoping rather than a Policy for a different reason (per-user ownership) — here there is no ownership check at all, which must be called out in review/PR description as intentional.
- `detach` takes both `{article}` and `{tag}` as route-bound params (two-segment URL) since detach is per-article-per-tag, unlike feedback which is one-per-user-per-article.

```ts
    body: { name },
  });
  return res.data;

export function deleteTag(tagId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/tags/${tagId}`, { method: "DELETE" });

export async function applyTagToArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tag: { tagId: number } | { name: string },
): Promise<Tag> {
  const body = "tagId" in tag ? { tag_id: tag.tagId } : { name: tag.name };
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: Tag }>(
    `/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags`,
    { method: "POST", body },
  );
  return res.data;
}

export function detachTagFromArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tagId: number,
): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(
    `/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags/${tagId}`,
    { method: "DELETE" },
  );
}
```

# Implementation Plan: News Article Tagging (Shared/Global Tags)

## 0. Design judgment calls (flagging up front)

1. **Uniqueness strategy for `tags.name`**: Verified — `config/database.php` defaults to `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` and the live MySQL is 8.0.46 (Ubuntu). `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` is case-insensitive and accent-sensitive-ish but for this purpose the key point is case folding: `'Politics'` and `'politics'` collide under a plain unique index on that column. A plain `$table-&gt;string('name')-&gt;unique()` is safe and sufficient — **no normalized/lowercase column needed**. Decision: store `name` exactly as first submitted (preserve casing of whoever created it first — RSS category text or user input), rely on the unique index + `firstOrCreate`/`upsert`-style lookups being done with the incoming value directly (MySQL's collation handles the case-insensitive match at the DB level, so `Tag::where('name', $value)-&gt;first()` will still find `'Politics'` when searching for `'politics'`). Trim whitespace before lookup/insert. Cap `name` length (`max:50`) to keep pills UI-friendly.
2. **Race condition on concurrent create**: `firstOrCreate` isn't atomic against a unique constraint under high concurrency; wrap tag resolution in a try/catch for `QueryException` (duplicate key) and re-fetch, OR simply rely on Laravel's `firstOrCreate` which already does a create-then-catch-unique-violation-then-refetch pattern internally as of modern Laravel — no extra code needed, just note it.
3. **Tag `destroy`**: no policy/ownership check at all (any authenticated user may delete any tag) — this is intentional per product decision #1, must be documented via a comment in the controller, not silently omitted.
4. **RSS additive-only tagging**: fetch command must only ever `attach` (never `sync`/`detach`) category-derived tags, so it never fights a user's manual detach or a user-applied tag.
5. **Attribution column** `applied_by_user_id` nullable, `nullOnDelete()` — null means system/RSS-applied; the RSS pipeline explicitly passes no user id (or a pivot row with `applied_by_user_id =&gt; null`).
6. **`attach` idempotency for both RSS and user action**: pivot has `unique(news_article_id, tag_id)` so re-attaching is a no-op; use `attach()` guarded by an `wherePivot` existence check, or wrap in try/catch for duplicate-key, or use `syncWithoutDetaching` for a single tag (simplest — `$article-&gt;tags()-&gt;syncWithoutDetaching([$tag-&gt;id])`, but this does NOT let us set `applied_by_user_id` per-row cleanly since sync doesn't set pivot attributes unless passed). Use `$article-&gt;tags()-&gt;syncWithoutDetaching([$tag-&gt;id =&gt; ['applied_by_user_id' =&gt; $userId]])` — this both handles idempotency and sets pivot attributes on insert. Note: `syncWithoutDetaching` will *update* pivot columns on existing rows too (it re-writes attributes for kept ids) — that's fine here (harmless overwrite with the same/newer attribution) but call this out.

```php
Schema::create('news_article_tag', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table-&gt;id();
    $table-&gt;foreignId('news_article_id')-&gt;constrained()-&gt;cascadeOnDelete();
    $table-&gt;foreignId('tag_id')-&gt;constrained()-&gt;cascadeOnDelete();
```

## 4. Backend: FetchNewsCommand changes

`app/Console/Commands/FetchNewsCommand.php`, inside `fetchSource()`'s `foreach ($items as $item)` loop, right after the `updateOrCreate` call:

```php
$article = NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(
    ['news_source_id' =&gt; $source-&gt;id, 'guid' =&gt; $item['guid']],
    [
        'title' =&gt; $item['title'],
        'url' =&gt; $item['url'],
        'summary' =&gt; $item['summary'],
        'image_url' =&gt; $item['image_url'],
        'published_at' =&gt; $item['published_at'],

```

New private method:
```php
private function attachCategoryTags(NewsArticle $article, array $categories): void
{
    foreach ($categories as $category) {
        $name = trim($category);
        if ($name === '' || mb_strlen($name) &gt; 50) {
            continue;
        }

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' =&gt; $name]);

        $article-&gt;tags()-&gt;syncWithoutDetaching([$tag-&gt;id =&gt; ['applied_by_user_id' =&gt; null]]);
    }
}
```
Note `applied_by_user_id =&gt; null` is safe/idempotent even on repeated runs — it does not clobber a user's own attribution to `null` in the common case, because if a user later independently applies the *same* tag via the `attach` endpoint, that call runs `syncWithoutDetaching([$tag-&gt;id =&gt; ['applied_by_user_id' =&gt; $userId]])` and correctly overwrites to the user's id; the RSS pass then re-running would overwrite back to `null` on the next fetch. This is an acceptable, documented edge case (attribution is best-effort/cosmetic only, not used for any authorization) — call this out explicitly in a code comment in `attachCategoryTags()` so it isn't mistaken for a bug later. Add `use App\Models\Tag;` import.

This is additive-only: no `sync()`/`detach()` call ever removes a tag based on feed content, satisfying requirement 4.

## 5. Backend: Controller `app/Http/Controllers/News/TagController.php` (new)

```php
namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\TagResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\Tag;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $tags = Tag::orderBy('name')-&gt;get();

        $counts = DB::table('news_article_tag')
            -&gt;select('tag_id', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as usage_count'))
            -&gt;groupBy('tag_id')
            -&gt;pluck('usage_count', 'tag_id');

        $tags-&gt;each(function (Tag $tag) use ($counts) {
            $tag-&gt;usage_count = (int) ($counts-&gt;get($tag-&gt;id) ?? 0);
        });

        return TagResource::collection($tags);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request-&gt;validate([
            'name' =&gt; ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' =&gt; trim($validated['name'])]);
        $tag-&gt;usage_count = $tag-&gt;articles()-&gt;count();

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    // No policy/authorize() call here by design: tags are a shared/global
    // resource with no ownership concept, so any authenticated user may
    // delete any tag entirely (removes it from every article, for every
    // user) — see product decision, not an oversight.
    public function destroy(Request $request, Tag $tag)
    {
        $tag-&gt;delete();

        return response()-&gt;noContent();
    }

    public function attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request-&gt;validate([
            'tag_id' =&gt; ['required_without:name', 'integer', 'exists:tags,id'],
            'name' =&gt; ['required_without:tag_id', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['tag_id'])) {
            $tag = Tag::findOrFail($validated['tag_id']);
        } else {
            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' =&gt; trim($validated['name'])]);
        }

        $article-&gt;tags()-&gt;syncWithoutDetaching([
            $tag-&gt;id =&gt; ['applied_by_user_id' =&gt; $request-&gt;user()-&gt;id],
        ]);

        $tag-&gt;usage_count = $tag-&gt;articles()-&gt;count();

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    public function detach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)
    {
        $article-&gt;tags()-&gt;detach($tag-&gt;id);

        return response()-&gt;noContent();
    }
}
```
Notes:
- `attach`/`detach` mirror `SourceController::store`'s "existing id OR name" pattern and `FeedbackController`'s per-article scoping style (route-model-bound `{article}`).
- No `TagPolicy` file — deliberately absent, matching the note that ownership-style policies don't fit a global resource; only `auth:sanctum` middleware gates writes, exactly as `FeedbackController` relies on manual `where('user_id', ...)` scoping rather than a Policy for a different reason (per-user ownership) — here there is no ownership check at all, which must be called out in review/PR description as intentional.
- `detach` takes both `{article}` and `{tag}` as route-bound params (two-segment URL) since detach is per-article-per-tag, unlike feedback which is one-per-user-per-article.

```ts
import type { NewsArticle, NewsSource, Tag } from "./news-types";

  return res.data;

export async function createTag(name: string): Promise&lt;Tag&gt; {
  const res = await apiFetch&lt;{ data: Tag }&gt;("/api/news/tags", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { name },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export function deleteTag(tagId: number): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
  return apiFetch&lt;void&gt;(`/api/news/tags/${tagId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function applyTagToArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tag: { tagId: number } | { name: string },
): Promise&lt;Tag&gt; {
  const body = "tagId" in tag ? { tag_id: tag.tagId } : { name: tag.name };
  const res = await apiFetch&lt;{ data: Tag }&gt;(
    `/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags`,
    { method: "POST", body },
  );
  return res.data;
}

export function detachTagFromArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tagId: number,
): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
  return apiFetch&lt;void&gt;(
    `/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags/${tagId}`,
    { method: "DELETE" },
  );
}
```

## 9. Verification

**RSS extraction (`php artisan news:fetch`)**
1. Add/point a `NewsSource` at a known RSS 2.0 feed with `&lt;category&gt;` tags (many news feeds have them, e.g. an NPR or BBC RSS feed) and one Atom feed with `&lt;category term="..."&gt;`.
2. Run `php artisan news:fetch` locally, then `php artisan tinker` and inspect: `Tag::pluck('name')`, `NewsArticle::first()-&gt;tags`.
3. Run the command a second time immediately; assert `Tag::count()` and per-article `tags()-&gt;count()` are unchanged (idempotency/no duplication) — check `news_article_tag` row `updated_at` bumped but no new rows.
4. Manually `detach()` a tag from an article via tinker, then re-run fetch with that category still present in the feed — assert it gets re-attached (expected, since RSS always re-asserts categories present in the feed; only a category *disappearing* from the feed leaves the tag alone, which is the "additive-only" guarantee, not persistence-of-manual-detach — worth confirming this nuance matches user expectation, since re-fetch will re-add a category a user manually removed as long as the RSS item still lists it).
5. Add a `RssParserTest`/extend existing test coverage (check `tests/` for existing `RssParserTest.php`) with a fixture containing `&lt;category&gt;Politics&lt;/category&gt;&lt;category&gt;World&lt;/category&gt;` (RSS) and `&lt;category term="Tech"/&gt;` (Atom), asserting `categories` key.

**Endpoint smoke tests**
- `GET /api/news/tags` — anonymous, expect 200 + array (possibly with `usage_count`).
- `POST /api/news/tags` unauthenticated — expect 401/419.
- Authenticated (via Sanctum cookie flow, e.g. Postman/curl with CSRF): `POST /api/news/tags {"name":"Foo"}` → 200, then repeat same name → same `id` returned (dedup).
- `POST /api/news/articles/{id}/tags {"name":"Foo"}` → 200, article now has tag; re-POST same → idempotent (still one pivot row).
- `DELETE /api/news/articles/{id}/tags/{tagId}` → 204, tag gone from that article only, `Tag` row still exists.
- `DELETE /api/news/tags/{tagId}` as a *different* authenticated user than whoever created it → 204 (confirms no ownership check, per design decision) — verify it's actually gone from `GET /api/news/feed` for all articles.
- `GET /api/news/feed` — confirm each article object includes a `tags: [{id,name}, ...]` array with no N+1 (check query log / `DB::listen` or Laravel Telescope/Debugbar query count stays constant regardless of article count).
- Run existing Laravel test suite: `php artisan test --filter=News` (or full suite) to catch regressions in `FeedControllerTest`/`SourceControllerTest`/etc. if they exist.

**Frontend build/typecheck**
- `cd web &amp;&amp; npm run build` (or `next build`) — confirms TS types (`Tag`, extended `NewsArticle`) compile cleanly and no missing prop errors in `ArticleCard`/`TagManager`/`NewsFeed`.
- `cd web &amp;&amp; npx tsc --noEmit` for a faster standalone typecheck if `build` is slow.
- `npm run lint` if ESLint is configured, to catch the same `no-img-element`-style conventions already suppressed elsewhere.
- Manual smoke: run `next dev`, load `/news` (or wherever `NewsFeed` is mounted) logged out (verify tag pills render, no edit affordances) and logged in (verify apply/detach/delete flows against a local API).

````markdown
# News article tagging

## Context

The News Feed already personalizes ranking via per-source "More/Less like
this" affinity, but there's no way to categorize or find articles by topic
beyond the coarse Local/Hackery/World source-level topics. The user wants a
proper tag system: (1) auto-extract tags from each RSS/Atom feed item's
`<category>` elements during the existing scheduled fetch, and (2) let any
logged-in user create, apply, and delete tags.

Confirmed product decisions:
- **Tags are shared/global**, not private per-user — any logged-in user can
  create a tag, apply an existing tag to any article, and delete any tag
  entirely (removes it from every article, for every user). Matches the
  user's explicit choice over the private-per-user alternative.
- **RSS-derived tags and user tags are the same table** — an RSS category
  "Politics" and a user manually tagging "Politics" resolve to one row
  (case-insensitive dedup). Also explicitly chosen by the user over keeping
  RSS categories as separate read-only metadata.
- Two distinct actions exist: **detach** (remove a tag from one article,
  low-risk) vs. **delete** (remove the tag entirely, global, destructive) —
  both are needed since "apply" and "delete" are named as separate verbs.

Verified: MySQL 8.0.46, default collation `utf8mb4_unicode_ci` (case
folding included), so a plain `unique()` index on `tags.name` handles
dedup — no separate normalized/slug column needed.

## Backend

**Migrations** (new):
- `tags`: `id, name (string:50, unique), timestamps`.
- `news_article_tag`: `id, news_article_id (FK cascade), tag_id (FK
  cascade), applied_by_user_id (nullable FK to users, nullOnDelete),
  timestamps; unique(news_article_id, tag_id); index(tag_id)`.
  `applied_by_user_id = null` means RSS/system-applied.

**Models**:
- New `app/Models/Tag.php` — `#[Fillable(['name'])]` (matches this
  codebase's attribute-based fillable convention, not `protected
  $fillable`), `articles(): BelongsToMany` to `NewsArticle` via
  `news_article_tag`, `withPivot('applied_by_user_id')`.
- `app/Models/NewsArticle.php` — add `tags(): BelongsToMany` to `Tag`,
  same pivot/withPivot.

**RSS parsing** (`app/Services/News/RssParser.php`):
- `<category>` elements aren't touched today. In `parseRss()`, inside the
  `foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item)` loop, collect `(string)
  $categoryEl` for each `$item->category` (RSS: plain text, repeatable).
  In `parseAtom()`, inside `foreach ($xml->entry as $entry)`, collect
  `(string) $categoryEl->attributes()->term` for each `$entry->category`
  (Atom: value is in the `term` attribute). Add `'categories' => [...]`
  to each item's returned array; update both method docblocks.

**Fetch command** (`app/Console/Commands/FetchNewsCommand.php`):
- Capture the return value of `NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(...)` (currently
  discarded) into `$article`.
- After it, for each category string: `Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' =>
  trim($category)])` (skip empty/`>50` chars), then `$article->tags()
  ->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => null]])`.
- **Additive only** — never `sync()`/`detach()` based on feed content, so
  a re-fetch can never remove a tag a user applied or fight a user's
  manual detach of an RSS-sourced tag. Note in a code comment: if a
  category is still present in the feed on a later fetch, it *will*
  re-attach even if a user detached it — that's expected/documented
  behavior, not a bug to fix in this iteration.

**Controller** — new `app/Http/Controllers/News/TagController.php`
(namespace `App\Http\Controllers\News`, matching `SourceController`/
`FeedbackController`):
- `index()` — public. `Tag::orderBy('name')->get()`, decorate with a
  bulk-computed `usage_count` (via one `DB::table('news_article_tag')
  ->groupBy('tag_id')` query, not per-tag).
- `store()` — auth required. Validate `name` (`required|string|max:50`),
  `Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($name)])` (dedup).
- `destroy(Tag $tag)` — auth required. `$tag->delete()` (cascades via FK).
  **No policy/ownership check** — intentional per the shared/global
  decision; add a code comment saying so explicitly, since it reads like
  a missing-auth bug otherwise. This is a deliberate deviation from the
  `TodoPolicy`-style ownership pattern used elsewhere, because tags have
  no owner concept.
- `attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)` — auth required.
  Accepts `tag_id` (existing) OR `name` (create-if-missing), mirroring
  `SourceController::store()`'s "existing id or inline create" pattern.
  `$article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id =>
  ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id]])`.
- `detach(NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)` — auth required.
  `$article->tags()->detach($tag->id)`.
- New `app/Http/Resources/TagResource.php` — `id, name, usage_count`
  (only include `usage_count` when set, via `$this->when(...)`).

**Feed response** (`app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedController.php`):
- Add a bulk tag lookup alongside the existing `$viewerFeedback` bulk
  load (same pattern — one `DB::table('news_article_tag')->join('tags',
  ...)->whereIn('news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))` query, then
  `->groupBy('news_article_id')`), and set a non-persisted
  `$article->article_tags = [...]` per article in the existing
  `$articles->each(...)` loop (named `article_tags`, not `tags`, to
  avoid clashing with the real `tags()` relation — same reasoning as the
  existing `viewer_feedback` vs. `feedback()` naming).
- `app/Http/Resources/NewsArticleResource.php` — add `'tags' =>
  $this->article_tags ?? []`. Unlike `feedback` (viewer-specific, uses
  `when()`), `tags` is unconditional/public so every article always has a
  stable array for the frontend to render.

**Routes** (`routes/api.php`, inside the existing `Route::prefix('news')`
group):
```php
Route::get('/tags', [TagController::class, 'index']);        // public, alongside /sources and /feed

Route::middleware('auth:sanctum')->group(function () {
    // ...existing routes...
    Route::post('/tags', [TagController::class, 'store']);
    Route::delete('/tags/{tag}', [TagController::class, 'destroy']);
    Route::post('/articles/{article}/tags', [TagController::class, 'attach']);
    Route::delete('/articles/{article}/tags/{tag}', [TagController::class, 'detach']);
});
```
Add `use App\Http\Controllers\News\TagController;` import.

## Frontend

- `web/src/lib/news-types.ts` — add `Tag = { id: number; name: string;
  usage_count?: number }`; extend `NewsArticle` with `tags: Tag[]`.
- `web/src/lib/news.ts` — add `getTags()`, `createTag(name)`,
  `deleteTag(tagId)`, `applyTagToArticle(articleId, {tagId} | {name})`,
  `detachTagFromArticle(articleId, tagId)`, all thin wrappers around
  `apiFetch` matching the existing functions in this file exactly.
- `web/src/components/news/article-card.tsx` — extend props with
  `canTag: boolean`, `allTags: Tag[]`, `onApplyTag`, `onDetachTag`. Render
  `article.tags` as small pills below the existing feedback buttons; when
  `canTag`, each pill gets a "×" calling `onDetachTag`, plus a small
  inline text input + button (styled like `SourceManager`'s custom-add
  form) that calls `onApplyTag(article.id, { name })` — the backend
  resolves new-vs-existing via `firstOrCreate`, so the frontend always
  sends by name here (no separate autocomplete-to-id step needed for v1).
- New `web/src/components/news/tag-manager.tsx` — structural sibling to
  `source-manager.tsx`: lists all tags (with usage counts) with a "×" per
  tag that calls `onDelete(tagId)` **behind a `window.confirm()`** (this
  is a global, irreversible delete — same `confirm()` pattern already
  used in `QuizRunner`'s "Finish" button). Logged-out view shows a
  read-only list + "Log in to manage tags" link, same shape as
  `SourceManager`'s logged-out branch.
- `web/src/components/news/news-feed.tsx` — add `tags` state, extend the
  existing `Promise.all([getSources(), getFeed(...)])` to also
  `getTags()`, add `handleApplyTag`/`handleDetachTag`/`handleDeleteTag`
  (each calls the API then `reload()`, matching existing handlers' shape
  exactly), pass tag props down to each `ArticleCard`, and render
  `<TagManager>` in the sidebar alongside `<SourceManager>` (wrap both in
  a `flex flex-col gap-4` container, since the sidebar currently holds
  only `SourceManager`).

## Verification

1. **RSS extraction**: point one `NewsSource` at a feed with `<category>`
   tags (e.g. an existing source or a temporary test one), run `php
   artisan news:fetch` locally, then in `tinker`: `Tag::pluck('name')`
   and `NewsArticle::first()->tags`. Run the command a second time
   immediately and confirm `Tag::count()` and per-article tag counts are
   unchanged (idempotent — no duplicate pivot rows).
2. **Endpoints**: `GET /api/news/tags` (public, 200), `POST
   /api/news/tags` unauthenticated (401/419), authenticated create +
   re-create same name (dedups to same id), `POST
   /api/news/articles/{id}/tags`, `DELETE .../tags/{tagId}` (detach —
   only that article loses it), `DELETE /api/news/tags/{tagId}` as a
   *different* user than whoever created it (succeeds — confirms the
   no-ownership-check decision), then confirm it's gone from `GET
   /api/news/feed` for every article. Run `php artisan test` for
   regressions.
3. **Frontend**: `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx eslint` on changed
   files; `npm run build`; manually load `/news` logged out (tags render
   read-only, no apply/detach UI) and logged in (apply, detach, delete
   flows work, delete prompts a confirm).
4. Deploy per the project's normal flow: `php artisan migrate --force`
   for the two new migrations, `sudo -u www-data npm run build` +
   `systemctl restart myeverything-web` for the frontend.
````

````text
  `$article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id =>
  ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id]])`.

  `$article->tags()->detach($tag->id)`.

  (only include `usage_count` when set, via `$this->when(...)`).

  `->groupBy('news_article_id')`), and set a non-persisted

  stable array for the frontend to render.

group):
````

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\TagResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\Tag;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $tags = Tag::orderBy('name')->get();

        $counts = DB::table('news_article_tag')
            ->select('tag_id', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as usage_count'))
            ->groupBy('tag_id')
            ->pluck('usage_count', 'tag_id');

        $tags->each(function (Tag $tag) use ($counts) {
            $tag->usage_count = (int) ($counts->get($tag->id) ?? 0);
        });

        return TagResource::collection($tags);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    /**
     * Tags are a shared/global resource with no ownership concept, so any
     * authenticated user may delete any tag entirely — this removes it
     * from every article, for every user. That's intentional, not a
     * missing authorization check.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, Tag $tag)
    {
        $tag->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tag_id' => ['required_without:name', 'integer', 'exists:tags,id'],
            'name' => ['required_without:tag_id', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['tag_id'])) {
            $tag = Tag::findOrFail($validated['tag_id']);
        } else {
            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
        }

        $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id],
        ]);

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    public function detach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)
    {
        $article->tags()->detach($tag->id);

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

```

```text
33	
34	        if ($sourceIds->isEmpty()) {
35	            return NewsArticleResource::collection(collect());
36	        }
37	
38	        $articlesQuery = NewsArticle::with('source')
39	            ->whereIn('news_source_id', $sourceIds);

43	            $articlesQuery->where(function ($inner) use ($escaped) {
44	                $inner->where('title', 'like', "%{$escaped}%")
45	                    ->orWhere('summary', 'like', "%{$escaped}%");
46	            });
47	        }
48	
49	        $articles = $articlesQuery
50	            ->orderByDesc('published_at')
51	            ->limit(300)
52	            ->get();

57	                ->select('news_source_id', DB::raw('SUM(direction) as score'))
58	                ->groupBy('news_source_id')
59	                ->pluck('score', 'news_source_id')
60	            : collect();
61	
62	        $viewerFeedback = $user
63	            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
64	                ->where('user_id', $user->id)

66	                ->pluck('direction', 'news_article_id')
67	            : collect();

71	                $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
```

```typescript
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { NewsArticle, Tag } from "@/lib/news-types";

function formatPublished(published_at: string | null): string {
  if (!published_at) return "";
  const date = new Date(published_at);
  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / 3_600_000);

  if (diffHours < 1) return "just now";
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  return `${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
}

export function ArticleCard({
  article,
  canRate,
  canTag,
  onFeedback,
  onApplyTag,
  onDetachTag,
}: {
  article: NewsArticle;
  canRate: boolean;
  canTag: boolean;
  onFeedback: (articleId: number, direction: 1 | -1) => void;
  onApplyTag: (articleId: number, name: string) => Promise<void>;
  onDetachTag: (articleId: number, tagId: number) => void;
}) {
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleAddTag(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = newTag.trim();
    if (name === "") return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onApplyTag(article.id, name);
      setNewTag("");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <li className="flex gap-4 rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10">
      {article.image_url && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img
          src={article.image_url}
          alt=""
          className="hidden h-20 w-28 flex-shrink-0 rounded object-cover sm:block"
        />
      )}
      <div className="flex-1">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">
          <span className="font-medium">{article.source.name}</span>
          {article.published_at && (
            <span>{formatPublished(article.published_at)}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        <a
          href={article.url}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >
          {article.title}
        </a>
        {article.summary && (
          <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {article.summary}
          </p>
        )}
        {canRate && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2 text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onFeedback(article.id, 1)}
              className={`rounded border px-2 py-1 ${
                article.feedback === 1
                  ? "border-foreground font-medium"
                  : "border-black/10 text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              More like this
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onFeedback(article.id, -1)}
              className={`rounded border px-2 py-1 ${
                article.feedback === -1
                  ? "border-foreground font-medium"
                  : "border-black/10 text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              Less like this
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {(article.tags.length > 0 || canTag) && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {article.tags.map((tag) => (
              <span
                key={tag.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-black/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
              >
                {tag.name}
                {canTag && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={`Remove tag ${tag.name}`}
                    onClick={() => onDetachTag(article.id, tag.id)}
                    className="hover:text-red-600"
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                )}
              </span>
            ))}
            {canTag && (
              <form onSubmit={handleAddTag} className="inline-flex">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="+ tag"
                  value={newTag}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTag(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="w-16 rounded-full border border-dashed border-black/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-white/20"
                />
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

```

```typescript
import Link from "next/link";
import type { Tag } from "@/lib/news-types";

export function TagManager({
  tags,
  canManage,
  onDelete,
}: {
  tags: Tag[];
  canManage: boolean;
  onDelete: (tagId: number) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  if (!canManage) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 text-sm dark:border-white/10">
        <p className="mb-1 font-medium">Tags</p>
        <Link href="/login" className="text-sm font-medium underline">
          Log in to manage tags
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  function handleDelete(tag: Tag) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete tag "${tag.name}"? This removes it from every article for everyone.`)) {
      return;
    }
    onDelete(tag.id);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10">
      <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium">All tags</p>
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        {tags.map((tag) => (
          <li
            key={tag.id}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
          >
            <span>
              {tag.name}
              {tag.usage_count !== undefined && (
                <span className="ml-1 text-zinc-500">
                  ({tag.usage_count})
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={`Delete tag ${tag.name}`}
              onClick={() => handleDelete(tag)}
              className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-600"
            >
              ×
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
        {tags.length === 0 && (
          <li className="text-sm text-zinc-500">No tags yet.</li>
        )}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

```

Design a detailed, execution-ready implementation plan for replacing an existing per-source article feedback feature with a per-tag voting feature, in a Laravel 13 API + Next.js frontend app at /var/www/jepflow.io/public/myeverything (api/ = Laravel, web/ = Next.js). Planning only — do not write any code or modify any files.

## Confirmed product decision
Fully remove the old per-source feedback system (table, model, controller, routes, frontend calls) — not just stop using it. Replace it with a new per-tag up/down voting system.

## Current state to replace (exact, as it exists right now — I just built both of these in this same session)

**Old per-source feedback system** (being removed entirely):
- Migration `database/migrations/2026_08_18_163614_create_news_article_feedback_table.php`: table `news_article_feedback` — `id, user_id (FK cascade), news_article_id (FK cascade), news_source_id (FK cascade), direction (smallInteger), timestamps; unique(user_id,news_article_id); index(user_id,news_source_id)`.
- Model `app/Models/NewsArticleFeedback.php`.
- Controller `app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedbackController.php`: `store()` does `NewsArticleFeedback::updateOrCreate(['user_id'=>...,'news_article_id'=>...], ['news_source_id'=>$article->news_source_id,'direction'=>$validated['direction']])`; `destroy()` does scoped `where(...)->delete()`.
- Routes in `routes/api.php` (inside `auth:sanctum` block of the `news` prefix group): `POST /news/articles/{article}/feedback`, `DELETE /news/articles/{article}/feedback`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedController.php::index()` — this is the feed-ranking endpoint. Currently: computes `$affinity` by summing `direction` from `news_article_feedback` grouped by `news_source_id` for the current user (`DB::table('news_article_feedback')->where('user_id',$user->id)->select('news_source_id', DB::raw('SUM(direction) as score'))->groupBy('news_source_id')->pluck('score','news_source_id')`), then ranks articles via `sortByDesc` where each article's sort key is `published_at_timestamp + boost * AFFINITY_HOURS(6) * 3600` and `$boost = (int) ($affinity->get($article->news_source_id) ?? 0)`. Also separately computes `$viewerFeedback` (per-article, for showing the current user's own vote state on each article) via `DB::table('news_article_feedback')->where('user_id',$user->id)->whereIn('news_article_id',$articles->pluck('id'))->pluck('direction','news_article_id')`, and sets `$article->viewer_feedback` per article inside the `$articles->each(...)` loop (alongside a similarly-shaped `$article->article_tags` I added for the tag feature, in the SAME loop — see below, don't break that).
- `app/Http/Resources/NewsArticleResource.php` currently exposes `'feedback' => $this->when($this->viewer_feedback !== null, fn () => $this->viewer_feedback)`.
- Frontend: `web/src/lib/news.ts` has `sendArticleFeedback(articleId, direction)` (POST) and `clearArticleFeedback(articleId)` (DELETE), both thin `apiFetch` wrappers.
- `web/src/lib/news-types.ts`: `NewsArticle` type has `feedback?: 1 | -1`.
- `web/src/components/news/article-card.tsx`: renders "More like this"/"Less like this" buttons (only when `canRate` prop true) that call `onFeedback(article.id, 1)` / `onFeedback(article.id, -1)`, highlighted via `article.feedback === 1`/`=== -1` comparison.
- `web/src/components/news/news-feed.tsx`: owns `handleFeedback(articleId, direction)` — toggle logic (if `article.feedback === direction` call `clearArticleFeedback`, else `sendArticleFeedback`), passes `onFeedback={handleFeedback}` and `canRate={status === "authenticated"}` down to each `ArticleCard`.

**Current (already-shipped, in the same session) tag system** — this is NOT being removed, and the new vote feature attaches to it:

"Let's get rid of the more/less like this buttons. Replace this with up and down arrows so that tags can be up/down voted." — i.e.:

```text
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsArticleFeedback;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class FeedbackController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'direction' => ['required', 'integer', 'in:1,-1'],
        ]);

        NewsArticleFeedback::updateOrCreate(
            ['user_id' => $request->user()->id, 'news_article_id' => $article->id],
            ['news_source_id' => $article->news_source_id, 'direction' => $validated['direction']],
        );

        return response()->json(['direction' => $validated['direction']]);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        NewsArticleFeedback::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->where('news_article_id', $article->id)
            ->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}
--- TagController ---
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\TagResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\Tag;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $tags = Tag::orderBy('name')->get();

        $counts = DB::table('news_article_tag')
            ->select('tag_id', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as usage_count'))
            ->groupBy('tag_id')
            ->pluck('usage_count', 'tag_id');

        $tags->each(function (Tag $tag) use ($counts) {
            $tag->usage_count = (int) ($counts->get($tag->id) ?? 0);
        });

        return TagResource::collection($tags);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    /**
     * Tags are a shared/global resource with no ownership concept, so any
     * authenticated user may delete any tag entirely — this removes it
     * from every article, for every user. That's intentional, not a
     * missing authorization check.
     */
    public function destroy(Request $request, Tag $tag)
    {
        $tag->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }

    public function attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tag_id' => ['required_without:name', 'integer', 'exists:tags,id'],
            'name' => ['required_without:tag_id', 'string', 'max:50'],
        ]);

        if (! empty($validated['tag_id'])) {
            $tag = Tag::findOrFail($validated['tag_id']);
        } else {
            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
        }

        $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id],
        ]);

        return new TagResource($tag);
    }

    public function detach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)
    {
        $article->tags()->detach($tag->id);

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}
```

```text
--- FeedController ---
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\News;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\NewsArticleResource;
use App\Models\NewsArticle;
use App\Models\NewsSource;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class FeedController extends Controller
{
    /** Each point of source affinity shifts an article's effective recency by this many hours. */
    private const AFFINITY_HOURS = 6;

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $limit = min((int) $request->integer('limit', 50), 100);
        $query = trim((string) $request->string('q'));
        $topic = trim((string) $request->string('topic'));

        $sources = $user
            ? $user->newsSources()
            : NewsSource::where('is_default', true);

        if ($topic !== '') {
            $sources->where('topic', $topic);
        }

        $sourceIds = $user ? $sources->pluck('news_sources.id') : $sources->pluck('id');

        if ($sourceIds->isEmpty()) {
            return NewsArticleResource::collection(collect());
        }

        $articlesQuery = NewsArticle::with('source')
            ->whereIn('news_source_id', $sourceIds);

        if ($query !== '') {
            $escaped = str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $query);
            $articlesQuery->where(function ($inner) use ($escaped) {
                $inner->where('title', 'like', "%{$escaped}%")
                    ->orWhere('summary', 'like', "%{$escaped}%");
            });
        }

        $articles = $articlesQuery
            ->orderByDesc('published_at')
            ->limit(300)
            ->get();

        $affinity = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->select('news_source_id', DB::raw('SUM(direction) as score'))
                ->groupBy('news_source_id')
                ->pluck('score', 'news_source_id')
            : collect();

        $viewerFeedback = $user
            ? DB::table('news_article_feedback')
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->whereIn('news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))
                ->pluck('direction', 'news_article_id')
            : collect();

        $tagsByArticle = DB::table('news_article_tag')
            ->join('tags', 'tags.id', '=', 'news_article_tag.tag_id')
            ->whereIn('news_article_tag.news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))
            ->select('news_article_tag.news_article_id', 'tags.id as tag_id', 'tags.name as tag_name')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('news_article_id');

        $articles = $articles
            ->sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($affinity) {
                $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
                $boost = (int) ($affinity->get($article->news_source_id) ?? 0);

                return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
            })
            ->values()
            ->take($limit);

        $articles->each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($viewerFeedback, $tagsByArticle) {
            $article->viewer_feedback = $viewerFeedback->has($article->id)
                ? (int) $viewerFeedback->get($article->id)
                : null;

            $article->article_tags = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())
                ->map(fn ($row) => ['id' => $row->tag_id, 'name' => $row->tag_name])
                ->values()
                ->all();
        });

        return NewsArticleResource::collection($articles);
    }
}
```

```text
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

#[Fillable(['user_id', 'news_article_id', 'news_source_id', 'direction'])]
class NewsArticleFeedback extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<\Database\Factories\NewsArticleFeedbackFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function article(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(NewsArticle::class, 'news_article_id');
    }

    public function source(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(NewsSource::class, 'news_source_id');
    }
}
```

```text
import { apiFetch } from "./api";
import type { NewsArticle, NewsSource, Tag } from "./news-types";

export async function getSources(): Promise<NewsSource[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource[] }>("/api/news/sources");
  return res.data;
}

export async function getFeed(
  limit = 50,
  q = "",
  topic = "",
): Promise<NewsArticle[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(limit) });
  if (q.trim() !== "") params.set("q", q.trim());
  if (topic.trim() !== "") params.set("topic", topic.trim());
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsArticle[] }>(
    `/api/news/feed?${params.toString()}`,
  );
  return res.data;
}

export async function addExistingSource(
  newsSourceId: number,
): Promise<NewsSource> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource }>("/api/news/sources", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { news_source_id: newsSourceId },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export async function addCustomSource(
  name: string,
  feedUrl: string,
): Promise<NewsSource> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource }>("/api/news/sources", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { name, feed_url: feedUrl },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export function removeSource(sourceId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/sources/${sourceId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function reorderSources(
  sourceIds: number[],
): Promise<NewsSource[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: NewsSource[] }>(
    "/api/news/sources/reorder",
    { method: "PATCH", body: { source_ids: sourceIds } },
  );
  return res.data;
}

export function sendArticleFeedback(
  articleId: number,
  direction: 1 | -1,
): Promise<{ direction: 1 | -1 }> {
  return apiFetch(`/api/news/articles/${articleId}/feedback`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: { direction },
  });
}

export function clearArticleFeedback(articleId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/articles/${articleId}/feedback`, {
    method: "DELETE",
  });
}

export async function getTags(): Promise<Tag[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: Tag[] }>("/api/news/tags");
  return res.data;
}

export async function createTag(name: string): Promise<Tag> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: Tag }>("/api/news/tags", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { name },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export function deleteTag(tagId: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/tags/${tagId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function applyTagToArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tag: { tagId: number } | { name: string },
): Promise<Tag> {
  const body = "tagId" in tag ? { tag_id: tag.tagId } : { name: tag.name };
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: Tag }>(
    `/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags`,
    { method: "POST", body },
  );
  return res.data;
}

export function detachTagFromArticle(
  articleId: number,
  tagId: number,
): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/news/articles/${articleId}/tags/${tagId}`, {
    method: "DELETE",
  });
}
```

```text
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { NewsArticle } from "@/lib/news-types";

function formatPublished(published_at: string | null): string {
  if (!published_at) return "";
  const date = new Date(published_at);
  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / 3_600_000);

  if (diffHours < 1) return "just now";
  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
  return `${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
}

export function ArticleCard({
  article,
  canRate,
  canTag,
  onFeedback,
  onApplyTag,
  onDetachTag,
}: {
  article: NewsArticle;
  canRate: boolean;
  canTag: boolean;
  onFeedback: (articleId: number, direction: 1 | -1) => void;
  onApplyTag: (articleId: number, name: string) => Promise<void>;
  onDetachTag: (articleId: number, tagId: number) => void;
}) {
  const [newTag, setNewTag] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleAddTag(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = newTag.trim();
    if (name === "") return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onApplyTag(article.id, name);
      setNewTag("");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <li className="flex gap-4 rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10">
      {article.image_url && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img
          src={article.image_url}
          alt=""
          className="hidden h-20 w-28 flex-shrink-0 rounded object-cover sm:block"
        />
      )}
      <div className="flex-1">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">
          <span className="font-medium">{article.source.name}</span>
          {article.published_at && (
            <span>{formatPublished(article.published_at)}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        <a
          href={article.url}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >
          {article.title}
        </a>
        {article.summary && (
          <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {article.summary}
          </p>
        )}
        {canRate && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2 text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onFeedback(article.id, 1)}
              className={`rounded border px-2 py-1 ${
                article.feedback === 1
                  ? "border-foreground font-medium"
                  : "border-black/10 text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              More like this
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onFeedback(article.id, -1)}
              className={`rounded border px-2 py-1 ${
                article.feedback === -1
                  ? "border-foreground font-medium"
                  : "border-black/10 text-zinc-500 hover:text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              Less like this
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {(article.tags.length > 0 || canTag) && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {article.tags.map((tag) => (
              <span
                key={tag.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-black/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
              >
                {tag.name}
                {canTag && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={`Remove tag ${tag.name}`}
                    onClick={() => onDetachTag(article.id, tag.id)}
                    className="hover:text-red-600"
                  >
                    ×
                  </button>
                )}
              </span>
            ))}
            {canTag && (
              <form onSubmit={handleAddTag} className="inline-flex">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="+ tag"
                  value={newTag}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTag(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="w-16 rounded-full border border-dashed border-black/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-white/20"
                />
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
```
