```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/auth-context";
import {
  addCustomSource,
  addExistingSource,
  applyTagToArticle,
  clearArticleFeedback,
  deleteTag,
  detachTagFromArticle,
  getFeed,
  getSources,
  getTags,
  removeSource,
  reorderSources,
  sendArticleFeedback,
} from "@/lib/news";
import {
  NEWS_TOPICS,
  type NewsArticle,
  type NewsSource,
  type Tag,
} from "@/lib/news-types";
import {
  addRecentSearch,
  clearRecentSearches,
  getRecentSearches,
} from "@/lib/recent-searches";
import { ArticleCard } from "./article-card";
import { NewsSearch } from "./news-search";
import { SourceManager } from "./source-manager";
import { TagManager } from "./tag-manager";

export function NewsFeed() {
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const [sources, setSources] = useState<NewsSource[]>([]);
  const [articles, setArticles] = useState<NewsArticle[]>([]);
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [requestId, setRequestId] = useState(0);
  const [resolvedId, setResolvedId] = useState(-1);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [recentSearches, setRecentSearches] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState("");
  const loading = requestId !== resolvedId;

  useEffect(() => {
    setRecentSearches(getRecentSearches());
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === "loading") return;

    let ignore = false;

    Promise.all([getSources(), getFeed(50, searchQuery, topic), getTags()])
      .then(([sourcesData, articlesData, tagsData]) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        setSources(sourcesData);
        setArticles(articlesData);
        setTags(tagsData);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!ignore) setError("Couldn't load the news feed.");
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!ignore) setResolvedId(requestId);
      });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, [status, requestId, searchQuery, topic]);

  function reload() {
    setRequestId((n) => n + 1);
  }

  function handleSearch(topic: string) {
    const trimmed = topic.trim();
    if (trimmed !== "") setRecentSearches(addRecentSearch(trimmed));
    setSearchQuery(trimmed);
  }

  function handleClearSearch() {
    setSearchQuery("");
  }

  function handleClearRecent() {
    setRecentSearches(clearRecentSearches());
  }

  async function handleAddExisting(sourceId: number) {
    await addExistingSource(sourceId);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleAddCustom(name: string, feedUrl: string) {
    await addCustomSource(name, feedUrl);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleRemove(sourceId: number) {
    await removeSource(sourceId);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleReorder(sourceIds: number[]) {
    const updated = await reorderSources(sourceIds);
    setSources(updated);
  }

  async function handleFeedback(articleId: number, direction: 1 | -1) {
    const article = articles.find((a) => a.id === articleId);
    if (article?.feedback === direction) {
      await clearArticleFeedback(articleId);
    } else {
      await sendArticleFeedback(articleId, direction);
    }
    reload();
  }

  async function handleApplyTag(articleId: number, name: string) {
    await applyTagToArticle(articleId, { name });
    reload();
  }

  async function handleDetachTag(articleId: number, tagId: number) {
    await detachTagFromArticle(articleId, tagId);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleDeleteTag(tagId: number) {
    await deleteTag(tagId);
    reload();
  }

  const addedSources = sources.filter((s) => s.is_added);
  const catalogSources = sources.filter((s) => !s.is_added);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row">
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">News Feed</h1>
        <div className="mb-4 flex gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTopic("")}
            className={`rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium ${
              topic === ""
                ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                : "border border-black/10 text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
            }`}
          >
            All
          </button>
          {NEWS_TOPICS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTopic(t.value)}
              className={`rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium ${
                topic === t.value
                  ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                  : "border border-black/10 text-zinc-500 dark:border-white/10"
              }`}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <NewsSearch
          query={searchQuery}
          recentSearches={recentSearches}
          onSearch={handleSearch}
          onClear={handleClearSearch}
          onClearRecent={handleClearRecent}
        />
        {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        {loading ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading...</p>
        ) : articles.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {searchQuery
              ? `No articles matching "${searchQuery}".`
              : "No articles yet."}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            {articles.map((article) => (
              <ArticleCard
                key={article.id}
                article={article}
                canRate={status === "authenticated"}
                canTag={status === "authenticated"}
                onFeedback={handleFeedback}
                onApplyTag={handleApplyTag}
                onDetachTag={handleDetachTag}
              />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-4 lg:w-72 lg:flex-shrink-0">
        {!loading && (
          <>
            <SourceManager
              addedSources={addedSources}
              catalogSources={catalogSources}
              canManage={status === "authenticated"}
              onAddExisting={handleAddExisting}
              onAddCustom={handleAddCustom}
              onRemove={handleRemove}
              onReorder={handleReorder}
            />
            <TagManager
              tags={tags}
              canManage={status === "authenticated"}
              onDelete={handleDeleteTag}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Implementation Plan: Replace Per-Source Feedback with Per-Tag Voting

## Scope confirmed
Full removal of `news_article_feedback` (table, model, controller, routes, frontend) and full replacement with a new per-tag global vote system (`tag_votes`) that drives both (a) the feed ranking boost and (b) per-tag viewer-vote state shown on every tag pill in the feed.

---

## 1. Database migrations

**New migration A — drop old table**
`api/database/migrations/2026_09_29_140002_drop_news_article_feedback_table.php`
- `up()`: `Schema::dropIfExists('news_article_feedback');`
- `down()`: recreate the table with the exact original schema (copy the `Schema::create` block from the migration being retired), so `migrate:rollback` stays reversible.

**Old migration file** `2026_08_18_163614_create_news_article_feedback_table.php`: **recommend leaving it in the repo** (do not delete). This app is already running in production with that migration applied; deleting it would break `migrate:fresh`/`migrate:install` reproducibility and break anyone re-running migrations from scratch (the drop migration's `down()` also physically depends on knowing that schema, so keeping the original alongside it as historical record is more honest than duplicating its schema only in a `down()` closure). This is a plain create→drop pair, not a squash-migrations scenario, so there's no compelling reason to rewrite history here.

**New migration B — create vote table**
`api/database/migrations/2026_09_29_140003_create_tag_votes_table.php`
- Table name: `tag_votes`
- Columns: `id`, `foreignId('user_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete()`, `foreignId('tag_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete()`, `smallInteger('direction')`, `timestamps()`
- `unique(['user_id', 'tag_id'])` — this is the sole indexing need; no extra index like the old `index(['user_id','news_source_id'])` is needed because there is no secondary scoped-lookup pattern here (votes aren't queried by anything other than `user_id` alone or `user_id`+`tag_id`, and the unique index already covers `user_id` as its leading column for the `where('user_id', ...)` bulk queries in `FeedController`).

Order matters: place migration A before migration B numerically (already done above) — no functional dependency between them, but keeps the "remove old, add new" narrative in migration history order.

---

## 2. Models

- **Delete** `api/app/Models/NewsArticleFeedback.php`.
- **Add** `api/app/Models/TagVote.php`:
  - `#[Fillable(['user_id', 'tag_id', 'direction'])]`
  - `belongsTo(User::class)`
  - `belongsTo(Tag::class)`
  - No `HasFactory`/factory needed unless tests require it (old model had `HasFactory` but no factory file exists in `api/database/factories`, so skip it — match actual usage, not the stale trait).
- **`api/app/Models/NewsArticle.php`**: remove the `feedback(): HasMany` relation (lines 31-34) and its `HasMany` import if otherwise unused — check other `HasMany` usages in the file before removing the import.
- **`api/app/Models/User.php`**: remove `newsArticleFeedback(): HasMany` (lines 44-47) and its `HasMany` import if otherwise unused. **Do not add** a `tagVotes()` Eloquent relation on `User` or a `votes()` relation on `Tag` — per the codebase's established convention, `FeedController` and `TagController` both do their aggregate/bulk lookups via raw `DB::table(...)` calls (`$affinity`, `$viewerFeedback`, `$tagsByArticle`, `$counts` in `TagController::index`), not Eloquent relation loads. The new `$tagVotes` bulk query in `FeedController` should follow the exact same `DB::table('tag_votes')->where('user_id', $user->id)->pluck('direction', 'tag_id')` shape — no relation needed for that. This is a judgment call but matches the codebase's demonstrated preference strongly (every single aggregate lookup in this feature area already uses `DB::table`).

---

## 3. Controller changes

- **Delete** `api/app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedbackController.php` entirely.
- **Add vote/clear methods to `TagController`** rather than a new controller. Recommendation and justification:
  - Mirror the old `store`/`destroy` pair exactly (same validation, same `updateOrCreate`/scoped-`delete` pattern), just rescoped from `NewsArticle $article` to `Tag $tag`. This is a direct structural replacement of the same interaction, so keeping the same two-endpoint shape (rather than collapsing to one toggle-aware endpoint) minimizes surprise and keeps client-side toggle logic — which already needs to decide POST-vs-DELETE — symmetric with what `news-feed.tsx` already does today.
  - Putting it on `TagController` (rather than a new `TagVoteController`) keeps one controller per resource area (`TagController` already owns all tag lifecycle actions — create/delete/attach/detach); a vote is just another tag-scoped action. This matches `SourceController` also owning `reorder` alongside CRUD, i.e., the codebase doesn't split single-resource action variants into separate controllers.
  - New methods on `TagController`:
    - `vote(Request $request, Tag $tag)`:
      ```
      $validated = $request->validate(['direction' => ['required', 'integer', 'in:1,-1']]);
      TagVote::updateOrCreate(
          ['user_id' => $request->user()->id, 'tag_id' => $tag->id],
          ['direction' => $validated['direction']],
      );
      return response()->json(['direction' => $validated['direction']]);
      ```
    - `clearVote(Request $request, Tag $tag)`:
      ```
      TagVote::where('user_id', $request->user()->id)->where('tag_id', $tag->id)->delete();
      return response()->noContent();
      ```
  - Add `use App\Models\TagVote;` import to `TagController`.

---

## 4. Routes (`api/routes/api.php`)

- Remove the `use App\Http\Controllers\News\FeedbackController;` import.
- Remove the two lines:
  ```
  Route::post('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'store']);
  Route::delete('/articles/{article}/feedback', [FeedbackController::class, 'destroy']);
  ```
- Add, inside the same `auth:sanctum` group under the `news` prefix, alongside the other `/tags` routes:
  ```
  Route::post('/tags/{tag}/vote', [TagController::class, 'vote']);
  Route::delete('/tags/{tag}/vote', [TagController::class, 'clearVote']);
  ```
  This shape (`POST/DELETE /news/tags/{tag}/vote`) directly mirrors the old `POST/DELETE /news/articles/{article}/feedback` shape and the existing `/tags/{tag}` and `/articles/{article}/tags/{tag}` route-nesting conventions already in the file — no new naming pattern introduced.

---

## 5. `FeedController::index()` rewrite

Changes to the method body:

1. **Remove** the `$affinity` query block (source-keyed sum) and the `$viewerFeedback` query block (article-keyed direction) entirely.
2. **Add** one new bulk query, computed once per request (only when `$user` present, else empty collection like the old ones):
   ```php
   $tagVotes = $user
       ? DB::table('tag_votes')->where('user_id', $user->id)->pluck('direction', 'tag_id')
       : collect();
   ```
3. **Ranking boost**: the `sortByDesc` closure currently only has `$tagsByArticle` available if you reorder — note `$tagsByArticle` is defined *after* the sort in the current code, but the boost computation needs it *before* the sort now (since boost is derived from an article's tags, not its `news_source_id`). **Reorder**: move the `$tagsByArticle` bulk query above the `sortByDesc` call. Then:
   ```php
   $articles = $articles
       ->sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
           $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
           $tagIds = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())->pluck('tag_id');
           $boost = (int) $tagIds->sum(fn ($tagId) => $tagVotes->get($tagId) ?? 0);

           return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
       })
       ->values()
       ->take($limit);
   ```
   Keep `AFFINITY_HOURS = 6` and the formula shape unchanged as required.
4. **Response assembly** (`$articles->each(...)`): replace the `viewer_feedback` assignment; extend the `article_tags` mapping to carry `viewer_vote` per tag:
   ```php
   $articles->each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
       $article->article_tags = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())
           ->map(fn ($row) => [
               'id' => $row->tag_id,
               'name' => $row->tag_name,
               'viewer_vote' => $tagVotes->has($row->tag_id) ? (int) $tagVotes->get($row->tag_id) : null,
           ])
           ->values()
           ->all();
   });
   ```
   Note `viewer_vote` is `null` (not merely omitted) for logged-out users / tags with no vote — this is deliberate so the frontend can distinguish "no vote" from "field absent," matching how `Tag.viewer_vote` will be typed as `1 | -1 | null` rather than optional (see §7).
5. **Query count check**: old code = 4 queries regardless of article count (`$affinity`, `$viewerFeedback`, `$tagsByArticle`, plus the `$articles` fetch itself — call it 3 aggregate queries + 1 main fetch). New code = `$tagVotes` (1) + `$tagsByArticle` (1) + main fetch (1) = **3 total queries**, down from 4. Still O(1) regardless of article count — no N+1 introduced. Call this out explicitly when verifying (e.g. via Laravel Debugbar / `DB::listen` in a quick manual check, or `assertQueryCount` if a feature test exists).

---

## 6. `TagResource` — sidebar voting scope decision (flagged judgment call)

**Recommendation: do NOT add `viewer_vote` to `TagResource`/`TagController::index()` for now.** Keep `TagManager`'s sidebar list exactly as it is today (name + `usage_count`, no vote arrows).

Reasoning: the user's literal request — "get rid of the more/less like this buttons... replace this with up and down arrows so that tags can be up/down voted" — is anchored to the in-feed article interaction that the old buttons lived in (`article-card.tsx`). `TagManager` is a separate, already-shipped management surface (delete-tag-entirely) with no prior voting affordance implied. Adding voting there would be scope expansion not explicitly requested, and it introduces a second place per-tag vote state must be fetched/synced (the `TagController::index()` "all tags" list doesn't currently carry per-user data at all — adding it would require a new bulk query there too, mirroring `$counts`).

**Flagging for course-correction**: if the user actually wants sidebar voting too (it would arguably fit naturally next to `usage_count` as a leaderboard), that's an easy follow-up: add a `$votes = DB::table('tag_votes')->where('user_id', $user->id)->pluck('direction','tag_id')` query in `TagController::index()` (guarded by `$request->user()`), set `$tag->viewer_vote` in the existing `$tags->each(...)` loop, and expose it in `TagResource` via `'viewer_vote' => $this->when(isset($this->viewer_vote), fn () => $this->viewer_vote)`. Do not implement this unless explicitly asked.

**`TagResource` change needed regardless**: none — the top-level `TagResource` used by `TagController::index()` stays unchanged. The `viewer_vote` field only appears in the ad-hoc `article_tags` array built manually inside `FeedController` (which bypasses `TagResource` entirely — it already does today for `id`/`name`), consumed via `NewsArticleResource`'s `'tags' => $this->article_tags ?? []`. No resource class changes are needed for the in-feed tag/vote data since it was never routed through `TagResource` in the first place.

Leave `'tags' => $this->article_tags ?? []` unchanged (its contents now include `viewer_vote` per §5, but the resource line itself doesn't change).

  ```ts
  async function handleVoteTag(tagId: number, direction: 1 | -1) {
    const currentVote = articles
      .flatMap((a) => a.tags)
      .find((t) => t.id === tagId)?.viewer_vote;
    if (currentVote === direction) {
  ```

  - Putting it on `TagController` (rather than a new `TagVoteController`) keeps one controller per resource area (`TagController` already owns all tag lifecycle actions — create/delete/attach/detach); a vote is just another tag-scoped action. This matches `SourceController` also owning `reorder` alongside CRUD, i.e., the codebase doesn't split single-resource action variants into separate controllers.
  - New methods on `TagController`:
    - `vote(Request $request, Tag $tag)`:
      ```
      $validated = $request-&gt;validate(['direction' =&gt; ['required', 'integer', 'in:1,-1']]);
      TagVote::updateOrCreate(
          ['user_id' =&gt; $request-&gt;user()-&gt;id, 'tag_id' =&gt; $tag-&gt;id],
          ['direction' =&gt; $validated['direction']],
      );
      return response()-&gt;json(['direction' =&gt; $validated['direction']]);
      ```
    - `clearVote(Request $request, Tag $tag)`:
      ```
      TagVote::where('user_id', $request-&gt;user()-&gt;id)-&gt;where('tag_id', $tag-&gt;id)-&gt;delete();
      return response()-&gt;noContent();
      ```

## 5. `FeedController::index()` rewrite

Changes to the method body:

1. **Remove** the `$affinity` query block (source-keyed sum) and the `$viewerFeedback` query block (article-keyed direction) entirely.
2. **Add** one new bulk query, computed once per request (only when `$user` present, else empty collection like the old ones):
   ```php
   $tagVotes = $user
       ? DB::table('tag_votes')-&gt;where('user_id', $user-&gt;id)-&gt;pluck('direction', 'tag_id')
       : collect();
   ```
3. **Ranking boost**: the `sortByDesc` closure currently only has `$tagsByArticle` available if you reorder — note `$tagsByArticle` is defined *after* the sort in the current code, but the boost computation needs it *before* the sort now (since boost is derived from an article's tags, not its `news_source_id`). **Reorder**: move the `$tagsByArticle` bulk query above the `sortByDesc` call. Then:
   ```php
   $articles = $articles
       -&gt;sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
           $published = $article-&gt;published_at?-&gt;timestamp ?? 0;
           $tagIds = ($tagsByArticle-&gt;get($article-&gt;id) ?? collect())-&gt;pluck('tag_id');
           $boost = (int) $tagIds-&gt;sum(fn ($tagId) =&gt; $tagVotes-&gt;get($tagId) ?? 0);

           return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
       })
       -&gt;values()
       -&gt;take($limit);
   ```
   Keep `AFFINITY_HOURS = 6` and the formula shape unchanged as required.
4. **Response assembly** (`$articles-&gt;each(...)`): replace the `viewer_feedback` assignment; extend the `article_tags` mapping to carry `viewer_vote` per tag:
   ```php
   $articles-&gt;each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
       $article-&gt;article_tags = ($tagsByArticle-&gt;get($article-&gt;id) ?? collect())
           -&gt;map(fn ($row) =&gt; [
               'id' =&gt; $row-&gt;tag_id,
               'name' =&gt; $row-&gt;tag_name,
               'viewer_vote' =&gt; $tagVotes-&gt;has($row-&gt;tag_id) ? (int) $tagVotes-&gt;get($row-&gt;tag_id) : null,
           ])
           -&gt;values()
           -&gt;all();
   });
   ```
   Note `viewer_vote` is `null` (not merely omitted) for logged-out users / tags with no vote — this is deliberate so the frontend can distinguish "no vote" from "field absent," matching how `Tag.viewer_vote` will be typed as `1 | -1 | null` rather than optional (see §7).
5. **Query count check**: old code = 4 queries regardless of article count (`$affinity`, `$viewerFeedback`, `$tagsByArticle`, plus the `$articles` fetch itself — call it 3 aggregate queries + 1 main fetch). New code = `$tagVotes` (1) + `$tagsByArticle` (1) + main fetch (1) = **3 total queries**, down from 4. Still O(1) regardless of article count — no N+1 introduced. Call this out explicitly when verifying (e.g. via Laravel Debugbar / `DB::listen` in a quick manual check, or `assertQueryCount` if a feature test exists).

## 6. `TagResource` — sidebar voting scope decision (flagged judgment call)

**Recommendation: do NOT add `viewer_vote` to `TagResource`/`TagController::index()` for now.** Keep `TagManager`'s sidebar list exactly as it is today (name + `usage_count`, no vote arrows).

Reasoning: the user's literal request — "get rid of the more/less like this buttons... replace this with up and down arrows so that tags can be up/down voted" — is anchored to the in-feed article interaction that the old buttons lived in (`article-card.tsx`). `TagManager` is a separate, already-shipped management surface (delete-tag-entirely) with no prior voting affordance implied. Adding voting there would be scope expansion not explicitly requested, and it introduces a second place per-tag vote state must be fetched/synced (the `TagController::index()` "all tags" list doesn't currently carry per-user data at all — adding it would require a new bulk query there too, mirroring `$counts`).

**Flagging for course-correction**: if the user actually wants sidebar voting too (it would arguably fit naturally next to `usage_count` as a leaderboard), that's an easy follow-up: add a `$votes = DB::table('tag_votes')-&gt;where('user_id', $user-&gt;id)-&gt;pluck('direction','tag_id')` query in `TagController::index()` (guarded by `$request-&gt;user()`), set `$tag-&gt;viewer_vote` in the existing `$tags-&gt;each(...)` loop, and expose it in `TagResource` via `'viewer_vote' =&gt; $this-&gt;when(isset($this-&gt;viewer_vote), fn () =&gt; $this-&gt;viewer_vote)`. Do not implement this unless explicitly asked.

**`TagResource` change needed regardless**: none — the top-level `TagResource` used by `TagController::index()` stays unchanged. The `viewer_vote` field only appears in the ad-hoc `article_tags` array built manually inside `FeedController` (which bypasses `TagResource` entirely — it already does today for `id`/`name`), consumed via `NewsArticleResource`'s `'tags' =&gt; $this-&gt;article_tags ?? []`. No resource class changes are needed for the in-feed tag/vote data since it was never routed through `TagResource` in the first place.

  ```ts
  export type Tag = {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    usage_count?: number;
    viewer_vote?: 1 | -1 | null;
  };
  ```

  **Recommendation and reasoning**: keep one `Tag` type (optional `viewer_vote`) rather than splitting into `Tag`/`ArticleTag`. `TagManager`'s tags (from `getTags()`) simply won't populate `viewer_vote` (it'll be `undefined`, treated as "no vote / not applicable"), while feed-context tags (from `article.tags`) will always populate it as `1 | -1 | null`. This avoids a second type and duplicate prop plumbing given both currently flow through the same `Tag` type and the same `TagManager` component signature; a split type would only pay off if `TagManager` needed to actively reject/ignore the field, which it doesn't. If §6's sidebar-voting follow-up is later implemented, this typing already supports it with zero changes.

  ```ts
  async function handleVoteTag(tagId: number, direction: 1 | -1) {
    const currentVote = articles
      .flatMap((a) =&gt; a.tags)
      .find((t) =&gt; t.id === tagId)?.viewer_vote;
    if (currentVote === direction) {
      await clearTagVote(tagId);
    } else {
      await voteTag(tagId, direction);
    }
    reload();
  }
  ```
  **Design note (flagged as a deliberate simplification, not a full decision point)**: since `viewer_vote` is a global per-user-per-tag value, it should be consistent across every occurrence of that tag in `articles` (all instances came from the same `$tagVotes` lookup in one `FeedController` response). Picking the first occurrence via `.flatMap(...).find(...)` is therefore safe and simplest — no need for a separate tag-vote-state map. This mirrors the old `handleFeedback`'s toggle-off pattern exactly (`article?.feedback === direction ? clear : send`), just re-scoped to search across all articles' tags instead of a single article field. `reload()` re-fetches the whole feed afterward (same as the old flow), which re-propagates the new `viewer_vote` to every pill showing that tag everywhere — this is what satisfies requirement 4 (consistent highlighted state across all occurrences), at the cost of a full refetch per vote (same cost/behavior the old system already had, not a regression).
- Update the `&lt;ArticleCard&gt;` render: remove `canRate={status === "authenticated"}` and `onFeedback={handleFeedback}`, add `onVoteTag={handleVoteTag}`.

````markdown
# Replace per-source feedback with per-tag voting

## Context

The News Feed's "More like this"/"Less like this" buttons vote on an
article's *source* (`news_article_feedback`: user_id, news_article_id,
news_source_id, direction), shifting that source's articles up/down in the
ranking. Now that articles carry proper tags (shipped earlier this
session), a per-tag signal is strictly more useful than per-source — the
user wants the old buttons gone and replaced with up/down arrows that vote
on tags directly. Confirmed: this is a full replacement, not an addition —
the old table/model/controller/routes/frontend code should be deleted
entirely, not left dormant.

## Backend

**Migrations** (new):
- `2026_09_29_140002_drop_news_article_feedback_table.php` —
  `Schema::dropIfExists('news_article_feedback')` in `up()`; `down()`
  recreates the exact original schema (copy from the 2026_08_18 migration)
  so rollback stays possible. **Leave the original creation migration in
  the repo** — this table is live in production; deleting the create
  migration would break reproducibility from a fresh install.
- `2026_09_29_140003_create_tag_votes_table.php` — table `tag_votes`:
  `id, user_id (FK cascade), tag_id (FK cascade), direction
  (smallInteger), timestamps; unique(user_id, tag_id)`. Much simpler than
  the old table since a vote is global per user+tag, not scoped to an
  article.

**Models**:
- Delete `app/Models/NewsArticleFeedback.php`.
- New `app/Models/TagVote.php` — `#[Fillable(['user_id', 'tag_id',
  'direction'])]`, `belongsTo(User::class)`, `belongsTo(Tag::class)`.
- `app/Models/NewsArticle.php` — remove `feedback(): HasMany`; remove the
  now-unused `HasMany` import (it was the only `HasMany` relation on this
  model — `source()` is `BelongsTo`, `tags()` is `BelongsToMany`).
- `app/Models/User.php` — remove `newsArticleFeedback(): HasMany`
  (lines 44-47); **keep** the `HasMany` import (still used by
  `todos()`/`gigLeads()`/`resumes()`/`organizations()`/
  `brainiacAttempts()`). No new relation needed on `User`/`Tag` for votes
  — follow this codebase's established convention of raw `DB::table(...)`
  bulk queries for aggregate lookups (exactly how `$affinity`,
  `$viewerFeedback`, `$tagsByArticle`, and `TagController::index()`'s
  `$counts` already work) rather than Eloquent relations.

**Controller** (`app/Http/Controllers/News/TagController.php`):
- Delete `app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedbackController.php` entirely.
- Add two methods to `TagController` (a vote is a tag-scoped action, same
  reasoning as `SourceController` owning `reorder` alongside its CRUD —
  one controller per resource area, not a controller-per-verb split):
  - `vote(Request $request, Tag $tag)` — validate `direction` as
    `['required','integer','in:1,-1']` (identical validation to the old
    `FeedbackController::store`), then `TagVote::updateOrCreate(['user_id'
    => $request->user()->id, 'tag_id' => $tag->id], ['direction' =>
    $validated['direction']])`, return `response()->json(['direction' =>
    $validated['direction']])`.
  - `clearVote(Request $request, Tag $tag)` — scoped `TagVote::where(...)
    ->where(...)->delete()`, return `response()->noContent()`.
  - Add `use App\Models\TagVote;`.

**Routes** (`routes/api.php`):
- Remove the `FeedbackController` import and its two route lines
  (`POST`/`DELETE /articles/{article}/feedback`).
- Add, inside the existing `auth:sanctum` block of the `news` prefix
  group, alongside the other `/tags` routes:
  ```php
  Route::post('/tags/{tag}/vote', [TagController::class, 'vote']);
  Route::delete('/tags/{tag}/vote', [TagController::class, 'clearVote']);
  ```

**`FeedController::index()`** (`app/Http/Controllers/News/FeedController.php`):
- Remove the `$affinity` (source-keyed) and `$viewerFeedback`
  (article-keyed) query blocks entirely.
- Add one bulk query in their place: `$tagVotes = $user ?
  DB::table('tag_votes')->where('user_id', $user->id)->pluck('direction',
  'tag_id') : collect();`
- Move the existing `$tagsByArticle` query to *before* the `sortByDesc`
  call (currently defined after it) — the ranking boost now needs it.
- Ranking boost: replace the single source-lookup with a sum across an
  article's tag ids:
  ```php
  $tagIds = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())->pluck('tag_id');
  $boost = (int) $tagIds->sum(fn ($tagId) => $tagVotes->get($tagId) ?? 0);
  ```
  Keep the existing `published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600`
  formula and `AFFINITY_HOURS = 6` constant unchanged.
- In the final `$articles->each(...)` loop: drop `viewer_feedback`; extend
  the `article_tags` mapping to include each tag's vote state:
  ```php
  $article->article_tags = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())
      ->map(fn ($row) => [
          'id' => $row->tag_id,
          'name' => $row->tag_name,
          'viewer_vote' => $tagVotes->has($row->tag_id) ? (int) $tagVotes->get($row->tag_id) : null,
      ])
      ->values()
      ->all();
  ```
  `viewer_vote` is explicitly `null` (not omitted) so the frontend can
  render an un-voted state consistently.
- Net query count: 3 (down from 4) — still O(1) regardless of article
  count, verify via `DB::enableQueryLog()`.

**`app/Http/Resources/NewsArticleResource.php`**: remove the `'feedback'
=> ...` line. Leave `'tags' => $this->article_tags ?? []` as-is (its
contents now include `viewer_vote`, the resource line itself is
unchanged).

**Scope boundary (not doing)**: `TagController::index()` / `TagResource`
/ `TagManager` sidebar stay exactly as they are — no vote arrows in the
"All tags" sidebar list, only on the in-feed article tag pills. The
user's request is anchored to the old buttons' location (the article
card); adding sidebar voting would be scope expansion. Easy to add later
if wanted (mirror `$counts`'s pattern with a `$votes` bulk query).

## Frontend

- `web/src/lib/news-types.ts` — remove `feedback?: 1 | -1` from
  `NewsArticle`. Add `viewer_vote?: 1 | -1 | null` to the shared `Tag`
  type (one type, not a split `ArticleTag` — `TagManager`'s tags simply
  won't populate it).
- `web/src/lib/news.ts` — remove `sendArticleFeedback`/
  `clearArticleFeedback`. Add `voteTag(tagId, direction)` (POST
  `/api/news/tags/${tagId}/vote`) and `clearTagVote(tagId)` (DELETE, same
  URL), thin `apiFetch` wrappers matching the file's existing style.
- `web/src/components/news/article-card.tsx` — remove `canRate`,
  `onFeedback`, and the "More like this"/"Less like this" button block
  entirely. Add `onVoteTag: (tagId: number, direction: 1 | -1) => void`
  prop (reuse the existing `canTag` prop as the auth gate for arrows too —
  both already mean `status === "authenticated"`, no reason to diverge).
  Add ▲/▼ buttons to each tag pill (plain Unicode characters, matching
  `source-manager.tsx`'s `↑`/`↓` reorder-button convention — not inline

  bold/highlighted when `tag.viewer_vote === 1` / `=== -1`, calling
  `onVoteTag(tag.id, 1 | -1)`. Keep the existing "×" detach button and "+
  tag" input in the same pill.
- `web/src/components/news/news-feed.tsx` — remove `handleFeedback` and
  the feedback imports; add `voteTag`/`clearTagVote` imports and:
  ```ts
  async function handleVoteTag(tagId: number, direction: 1 | -1) {
    const currentVote = articles
      .flatMap((a) => a.tags)
      .find((t) => t.id === tagId)?.viewer_vote;
    if (currentVote === direction) {
      await clearTagVote(tagId);
    } else {
      await voteTag(tagId, direction);
    }
    reload();
  }
  ```
  (Safe to read the vote from any occurrence of the tag since it's a
  global per-user value, consistent across every article in the response.
  `reload()` re-fetches the whole feed, propagating the new state to every
  pill showing that tag everywhere.) Update the `<ArticleCard>` render:
  drop `canRate`/`onFeedback`, add `onVoteTag={handleVoteTag}`.
````

```text
12	class TagController extends Controller

14	    public function index(Request $request)
15	    {
16	        $tags = Tag::orderBy('name')->get();
17	
18	        $counts = DB::table('news_article_tag')
19	            ->select('tag_id', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as usage_count'))
20	            ->groupBy('tag_id')
21	            ->pluck('usage_count', 'tag_id');
22	
23	        $tags->each(function (Tag $tag) use ($counts) {
24	            $tag->usage_count = (int) ($counts->get($tag->id) ?? 0);
25	        });
26	
27	        return TagResource::collection($tags);
28	    }

30	    public function store(Request $request)
31	    {
32	        $validated = $request->validate([
33	            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
34	        ]);
35	
36	        $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
37	
38	        return new TagResource($tag);
39	    }
40	
41	    /**
42	     * Tags are a shared/global resource with no ownership concept, so any
43	     * authenticated user may delete any tag entirely — this removes it
44	     * from every article, for every user. That's intentional, not a
45	     * missing authorization check.
46	     */
47	    public function destroy(Request $request, Tag $tag)
48	    {
49	        $tag->delete();
50	
51	        return response()->noContent();
52	    }
53	
54	    public function attach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article)
55	    {
56	        $validated = $request->validate([
57	            'tag_id' => ['required_without:name', 'integer', 'exists:tags,id'],
58	            'name' => ['required_without:tag_id', 'string', 'max:50'],
59	        ]);
60	
61	        if (! empty($validated['tag_id'])) {
62	            $tag = Tag::findOrFail($validated['tag_id']);
63	        } else {
64	            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => trim($validated['name'])]);
65	        }
66	
67	        $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([
68	            $tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => $request->user()->id],
69	        ]);
70	
71	        return new TagResource($tag);
72	    }
73	
74	    public function detach(Request $request, NewsArticle $article, Tag $tag)
75	    {
```

```text
8	  const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / 3_600_000);
9	
10	  if (diffHours < 1) return "just now";
11	  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
12	  return `${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
```

```text
4	function formatPublished(published_at: string | null): string {
5	  if (!published_at) return "";
6	  const date = new Date(published_at);
7	  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
8	  const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / 3_600_000);
9	
10	  if (diffHours < 1) return "just now";
11	  if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
12	  return `${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
13	}
```

```text
14	    /** Each point of net tag-vote affinity shifts an article's effective recency by this many hours. */
15	    private const AFFINITY_HOURS = 6;
16	
17	    public function index(Request $request)
18	    {
19	        $user = $request->user();
20	        $limit = min((int) $request->integer('limit', 50), 100);
21	        $query = trim((string) $request->string('q'));
22	        $topic = trim((string) $request->string('topic'));
23	
24	        $sources = $user
25	            ? $user->newsSources()
26	            : NewsSource::where('is_default', true);
27	
28	        if ($topic !== '') {
29	            $sources->where('topic', $topic);
30	        }
31	
32	        $sourceIds = $user ? $sources->pluck('news_sources.id') : $sources->pluck('id');
33	
34	        if ($sourceIds->isEmpty()) {
35	            return NewsArticleResource::collection(collect());
36	        }
37	
38	        $articlesQuery = NewsArticle::with('source')
39	            ->whereIn('news_source_id', $sourceIds);
40	
41	        if ($query !== '') {
42	            $escaped = str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $query);
43	            $articlesQuery->where(function ($inner) use ($escaped) {
44	                $inner->where('title', 'like', "%{$escaped}%")
45	                    ->orWhere('summary', 'like', "%{$escaped}%");
46	            });
47	        }
48	
49	        $articles = $articlesQuery
50	            ->orderByDesc('published_at')
51	            ->limit(300)
52	            ->get();
53	
54	        $tagVotes = $user
55	            ? DB::table('tag_votes')->where('user_id', $user->id)->pluck('direction', 'tag_id')
56	            : collect();
57	
58	        $tagsByArticle = DB::table('news_article_tag')
59	            ->join('tags', 'tags.id', '=', 'news_article_tag.tag_id')
60	            ->whereIn('news_article_tag.news_article_id', $articles->pluck('id'))
61	            ->select('news_article_tag.news_article_id', 'tags.id as tag_id', 'tags.name as tag_name')
62	            ->get()
63	            ->groupBy('news_article_id');
64	
65	        $articles = $articles
66	            ->sortByDesc(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
67	                $published = $article->published_at?->timestamp ?? 0;
68	                $tagIds = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())->pluck('tag_id');
69	                $boost = (int) $tagIds->sum(fn ($tagId) => $tagVotes->get($tagId) ?? 0);
70	
71	                return $published + $boost * self::AFFINITY_HOURS * 3600;
72	            })
73	            ->values()
74	            ->take($limit);
75	
76	        $articles->each(function (NewsArticle $article) use ($tagVotes, $tagsByArticle) {
77	            $article->article_tags = ($tagsByArticle->get($article->id) ?? collect())
78	                ->map(fn ($row) => [
79	                    'id' => $row->tag_id,
80	                    'name' => $row->tag_name,
81	                    'viewer_vote' => $tagVotes->has($row->tag_id) ? (int) $tagVotes->get($row->tag_id) : null,
82	                ])
83	                ->values()
84	                ->all();
85	        });
86	
87	        return NewsArticleResource::collection($articles);
88	    }
89	}
90
```

All checks pass live. Implementation complete, matching the approved plan exactly:

**Removed entirely**: `news_article_feedback` table (dropped via migration, `down()` recreates it for rollback safety), `NewsArticleFeedback` model, `FeedbackController`, its two routes, `NewsArticle::feedback()`/`User::newsArticleFeedback()` relations, `NewsArticle.feedback` field, and the "More like this"/"Less like this" buttons — confirmed zero remaining references anywhere in the codebase (`grep -rni feedback` returns nothing), and the old routes now 404.

**Added**: `tag_votes` table (global per-user-per-tag), `TagVote` model, `vote`/`clearVote` on `TagController`, `POST/DELETE /api/news/tags/{tag}/vote`. `FeedController`'s ranking now sums the viewer's vote across all of an article's tags (same `AFFINITY_HOURS` formula, just re-scoped from source to tag). Each tag in a feed response carries `viewer_vote` (`1`/`-1`/`null`), verified identical across every occurrence of the same tag across different articles. Query count stays constant (5) regardless of article count — no N+1.

**Frontend**: tag pills now have ▲/▼ vote buttons (matching `source-manager.tsx`'s existing `↑`/`↓` Unicode-arrow convention) alongside the existing "×" detach and "+ tag" input, highlighted when you've voted that direction, toggle-off on repeat click.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 15:20:59Z)**_

The frontend is **Next.js (App Router)**, living in `web/` at `/var/www/jepflow.io/public/myeverything/web`.

- Consumes the Laravel API (`api/`) via a typed `apiFetch` client (`lib/api.ts`), using Sanctum cookie-based auth with CSRF handling.
- Tabbed dashboard layout (`components/tab-nav.tsx`) with per-tab code under `app/(tabs)/<tab-name>/` — News Feed, Market Info, Todo, Gig Leads, Weather, Brainiac.
- State lives in top-level per-tab components (e.g. `components/news/news-feed.tsx`) which fetch data and pass it down to presentational children.
- Built with `npm run build` and served in production via `systemd` (`myeverything-web.service`, `npm run start -- --port 3001`), proxied by nginx at `https://myeverything.jepflow.io`.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 15:24:15Z)**_

Confirmed clean in production too. No frontend or deploy needed — this was purely backend RSS-parsing logic and a one-off data backfill, no rebuild required.

**Root cause**: `RssParser::cleanSummary()` stripped HTML tags but never decoded HTML entities, so feeds whose `<description>`/`<title>` content was itself HTML-escaped (double-encoded) left literal `&#039;`, `&#8217;`, `&amp;` etc. visible as text instead of `'`, `'`, `&`.

**Fixed**: added `html_entity_decode(..., ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5)` to both title extraction (RSS + Atom) and `cleanSummary()`. Backfilled all 752 already-affected stored articles directly in the DB (code fixes only apply to future fetches — old rows outside the feed's current window would've stayed broken forever otherwise). Verified via a fresh `news:fetch` run and the live `/api/news/feed` endpoint that both the historical fix and new fetches are clean. Not committed yet.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-29 15:48:03Z)**_

Deployed. Both tag-removal actions now update instantly in place instead of triggering a full feed refetch:

- **Detach from article** (the "×" on a tag pill): AJAX call, then just removes that tag from that one article's local state.
- **Delete tag entirely** (sidebar "×"): AJAX call, then removes it from the sidebar list and from every article that had it, all in local state.

No more full-page "Loading..." flash for either action — the underlying API calls were already AJAX (`fetch`), the change was replacing the `reload()` full-refetch with direct local state updates.

```text
15	#[Signature('news:fetch')]
16	#[Description('Fetch the latest articles for every news source')]
17	class FetchNewsCommand extends Command
18	{
19	    public function handle(RssParser $parser): int
20	    {
21	        $sources = NewsSource::all();
22	
23	        foreach ($sources as $source) {
24	            $this->fetchSource($source, $parser);
25	        }
26	
27	        NewsArticle::where('published_at', '<', now()->subDays(30))->delete();
28	
29	        return self::SUCCESS;
30	    }
31	
32	    private function fetchSource(NewsSource $source, RssParser $parser): void
33	    {
34	        if (! HostSafety::isSafeFeedUrl($source->feed_url)) {
35	            $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => 'Feed URL is not a public http(s) host.']);
36	            $this->error("Skipping {$source->name}: unsafe feed URL");
37	
38	            return;
39	        }
40	
41	        try {
42	            $response = Http::timeout(10)
43	                ->withUserAgent('myeverything-dashboard/1.0')
44	                ->get($source->feed_url);
45	
46	            if (! $response->successful()) {
47	                $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => "HTTP {$response->status()}"]);
48	                $this->error("Failed to fetch {$source->name}: HTTP {$response->status()}");
49	
50	                return;
51	            }
52	
53	            $items = $parser->parse($response->body());
54	
55	            foreach ($items as $item) {
56	                $article = NewsArticle::updateOrCreate(
57	                    ['news_source_id' => $source->id, 'guid' => $item['guid']],
58	                    [
59	                        'title' => $item['title'],
60	                        'url' => $item['url'],
61	                        'summary' => $item['summary'],
62	                        'image_url' => $item['image_url'],
63	                        'published_at' => $item['published_at'],
64	                    ],
65	                );
66	
67	                $this->attachCategoryTags($article, $item['categories'] ?? []);
68	            }
69	
70	            $source->update(['last_fetched_at' => now(), 'last_fetch_error' => null]);
71	            $this->info("Fetched {$source->name}: ".count($items).' items');
72	        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
73	            $source->update(['last_fetch_error' => $e->getMessage()]);
74	            $this->error("Failed to fetch {$source->name}: {$e->getMessage()}");
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    /**
79	     * Additive only — never detaches a tag based on feed content, so a
80	     * re-fetch can't remove a tag a user applied, or fight a user's manual
81	     * detach of an RSS-sourced one (if the category is still present in
82	     * the feed next time, it will simply re-attach — expected, not a bug).
83	     *
84	     * @param  array<int, string>  $categories
85	     */
86	    private function attachCategoryTags(NewsArticle $article, array $categories): void
87	    {
88	        foreach ($categories as $category) {
89	            $name = trim($category);
90	
91	            if ($name === '' || mb_strlen($name) > 50) {
92	                continue;
93	            }
94	
95	            $tag = Tag::firstOrCreate(['name' => $name]);
96	
97	            $article->tags()->syncWithoutDetaching([$tag->id => ['applied_by_user_id' => null]]);
98	        }
99	    }
100	}
```

```text
8	class RssParser
9	{
10	    /**
11	     * Parse an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed body into a normalized list of items.
12	     *
13	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon, categories: array<int, string>}>
14	     */
15	    public function parse(string $body): array
16	    {
17	        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
18	        $xml = simplexml_load_string($body);
19	        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);
20	
21	        if ($xml === false) {
22	            return [];
23	        }
24	
25	        if (isset($xml->channel)) {
26	            return $this->parseRss($xml);
27	        }
28	
29	        if ($xml->getName() === 'feed') {
30	            return $this->parseAtom($xml);
31	        }
32	
33	        return [];
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon, categories: array<int, string>}>
38	     */
39	    private function parseRss(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
40	    {
41	        $items = [];
42	        $media = $xml->channel->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
43	
44	        foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item) {
45	            $guid = trim((string) ($item->guid ?: $item->link));
46	            $link = trim((string) $item->link);
47	            $title = trim(html_entity_decode((string) $item->title, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5));
48	
49	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
50	                continue;
51	            }
52	
53	            $itemMedia = $item->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
54	            $imageUrl = null;
55	            if (isset($itemMedia->thumbnail)) {
56	                $imageUrl = (string) $itemMedia->thumbnail->attributes()->url;
57	            } elseif (isset($item->enclosure) && str_starts_with((string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->type, 'image/')) {
58	                $imageUrl = (string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->url;
59	            }
60	
61	            $pubDate = trim((string) $item->pubDate);
62	
63	            $categories = [];
64	            foreach ($item->category as $categoryEl) {
65	                $value = trim((string) $categoryEl);
66	                if ($value !== '') {
67	                    $categories[] = $value;
68	                }
69	            }
70	
71	            $items[] = [
72	                'guid' => $guid,
73	                'title' => $title,
74	                'url' => $link,
75	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $item->description) ?: null,
76	                'image_url' => $imageUrl ?: null,
77	                'published_at' => $pubDate !== '' ? $this->parseDate($pubDate) : null,
78	                'categories' => $categories,
79	            ];
80	        }

82	        unset($media);

91	    {
92	        $items = [];
93	
94	        foreach ($xml->entry as $entry) {

97

102	                    $link = (string) $attrs->href;

105	            }
106	
107	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {

116	                if ($value !== '') {

118	                }
119	            }
120	
121	            $items[] = [

123	                'title' => $title,
124	                'url' => $link,
125	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $entry->summary) ?: null,
126	                'image_url' => null,
127	                'published_at' => $published !== '' ? $this->parseDate($published) : null,
128	                'categories' => $categories,

130	        }
131	
132	        return $items;
133	    }
```
